// THE FIXTURE OF SMURG 0.6.0 (packages/daemon/test/fixtures/published/0.6.0/): what the code of tag v0.6.0 writes on a
// host's computer, made by that code (DESIGN 0.7.0 D1 "How it is made"; the procedure of the 0.5.x fixtures' READMEs).
//
// Kept in the repository as packages/daemon/test/fixtures/drivers/fixture-driver-0.6.0.ts.txt. It runs IN A TREE OF
// THE TAG, never in a later tree: `git archive v0.6.0 | tar -x -C <tag>`, `source scripts/env.sh`, `pnpm install
// --frozen-lockfile --offline` (with the repository's package store), this file copied to
// <tag>/tests/e2e/test/fx-060.test.ts, and then, from <tag>:
//
//   SMURG_FX_OUT=<an empty folder> TMPDIR=<a scratch folder> pnpm exec vitest run --project @smurg/e2e tests/e2e/test/fx-060.test.ts
//
// It takes about nine minutes (six and a half of them a wait for the escalations). SMURG_FX_OUT gets progress.log (what
// the story did, step by step), raw/ (the two pictures as they were taken), fixture/ (what goes into the repository
// but README.md: files.json, coverage.json, ledger.json and the stored files of both variants), gaps.txt (a point of a
// schema no file visits and no reason names: it must be empty) and summary.json. The folder of the story itself is a
// short one made by the tree's own createTempRunDir (the sockets of SMURG_HOME/run must fit a Unix socket path) and is
// removed at the end. Two switches serve while the driver is changed: SMURG_FX_STOP_AFTER=<n> runs the first n steps and
// then the pictures, SMURG_FX_WAIT_MS shortens the wait; a fixture is made with neither.
//
// What it uses is the tree's own test support and nothing else: the relay of the tree in a local workerd with its dev
// login (`@smurg/relay/testing` startLocalRelay), told about a GitHub that is the relay tests' own mock
// (apps/relay/test/mock-idp.ts); the stand-in for Claude Code of the tree (`@smurg/daemon/testing` installFakeClaude),
// first on the PATH as `claude`; the command from source (`node packages/cli/src/main.ts`) as processes of their own;
// people as clients of the client library (`@smurg/protocol/client`) whose device key and pins are files in the
// command's format (`devices/<label>/`). No real Claude Code runs, nothing is billed, the built-in relay is never named
// (every command gets `--relay`), nobody's own ~/.smurg is touched (HOME, SMURG_HOME and SMURG_CACHE_DIR are scratch
// folders), SMURG_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1, no network but 127.0.0.1.
//
// ONE host home, four shared folders (workspaces), in this order in its workspaces.json:
//   (a) project/   the Bookshop of the 0.5.x fixtures, played by 0.6.0's code: the tree's own story
//                  (t.topic-flow.test.ts) and then the rest of the 0.5.x story, with what 0.6.0 adds (a topic whose
//                  model and mode a person chose, a session whose model a person chose, a teammate's command in auto
//                  mode for each of smurg's new gate reasons, a block of auto mode's check, a model the agent cannot use);
//   (b) b052/      the `stopped` picture of the 0.5.2 fixture (both its workspaces), made with the tree's own copy step
//                  and opened by this code: the kept copies of the step from 0.5.0, and the host's notice `agents-auto`;
//   (c) nogit/     a folder without .git: smurg's own history (.smurg/git), a Start and a merge;
//   (d) direct/    shared with no git program on PATH: a Start whose item runs directly in the folder.
// Then the picture `running` (smurg host of (a) running), `smurg stop`, the picture `stopped`, and the fixture files
// (files.json; coverage.json, whose reasons for what no file visits are REASONS and ENUM_REASONS below; ledger.json).
// README.md is written by hand from what this leaves in SMURG_FX_OUT.

const run = promisify(execFile);
const TREE = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../..', import.meta.url)).replace(/\/$/, '');

const OUT = process.env['SMURG_FX_OUT'] ?? '';
const MIB = 1024 * 1024;

/** Everything of the story lives below ROOT (a short folder: the daemon's sockets are in <ROOT>/host/run). */
let ROOT = '';
const P = {
  get project() {
    return join(ROOT, 'project');
  },
  get outside() {
    return join(ROOT, 'outside');
  },
  get home() {
    return join(ROOT, 'home');
  },
  get host() {
    return join(ROOT, 'host');
  },
  get cache() {
    return join(ROOT, 'cache');
  },
  get claudeDir() {
    return join(ROOT, 'claude');
  },
  get devices() {
    return join(ROOT, 'devices');
  },
  get cliMember() {
    return join(ROOT, 'cli-member');
  },
  get cliHome() {
    return join(ROOT, 'cli-home');
  },
  get gitHome() {
    return join(ROOT, 'git-home');
  },
};

let relay: LocalRelay;
let idp: MockIdp;
let claude: FakeClaude;
const logLines: string[] = [];
/** A line of what the story did, in SMURG_FX_OUT/progress.log (read while it runs). */
function note(line: string): void {
  const text = `${new Date().toISOString()} ${line}`;
  logLines.push(text);
  if (OUT !== '') appendFileSync(join(OUT, 'progress.log'), `${text}\n`);
}

/** The ledger of the fixture: what the people held (invite links with their secrets, ids the tests name). */
const ledger: Record<string, unknown> & { invites: Record<string, { url: string; id: string; role: string; maxUses?: number; expiresInSec?: number; createdAt?: number; expiresAt?: number; revoked?: boolean }> } = { invites: {} };

/** The environment of every command of the host (PATH: the stand-in first; git and the system tools after it). */
function hostEnv(extra: Record<string, string> = {}, path = `${P.claudeDir}:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin`): NodeJS.ProcessEnv {
  return {
    PATH: path,
    HOME: P.home,
    SMURG_HOME: P.host,
    SMURG_CACHE_DIR: P.cache,
    SMURG_NO_UPDATE_CHECK: '1',
    SMURG_NO_BROWSER: '1',
    SMURG_LANG: 'en',
    LANG: 'en_US.UTF-8',
    TMPDIR: process.env['TMPDIR'] ?? '/tmp',
    ...extra,
  };
}

/** `smurg <args>` to its end. */
async function smurg(args: readonly string[], env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = hostEnv(), input?: string): Promise<{ code: number; out: string }> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const child = spawn(process.execPath, [CLI_MAIN, ...args], { cwd: ROOT, env, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    if (child.pid !== undefined) registerTestProcess(child.pid, CLI_MAIN);
    let out = '';
    child.stdout.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => (out += chunk.toString('utf8')));
    child.stderr.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => (out += chunk.toString('utf8')));
    if (input !== undefined) child.stdin.end(input);
    else child.stdin.end();
    child.once('exit', (code) => resolve({ code: code ?? -1, out }));
  });
}

/** One `smurg host` of a folder, running. */
interface HostRun {
  readonly folder: string;
  readonly args: readonly string[];
  readonly child: ChildProcess;
  readonly hostLink: string;
  readonly teammatesLink: string;
  readonly workspaceId: string;
  out(): string;
  readonly exited: Promise<number | null>;
}
const runs: HostRun[] = [];
const starts: { folder: string; args: string[]; hostLink: string; teammatesLink: string; out: string }[] = [];

async function smurgHost(folder: string, extraArgs: readonly string[] = [], env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = hostEnv()): Promise<HostRun> {
  const args = ['host', folder, '--relay', relay.origin, ...extraArgs, '--no-keep-awake'];
  const child = spawn(process.execPath, [CLI_MAIN, ...args], { cwd: ROOT, env, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
  if (child.pid !== undefined) registerTestProcess(child.pid, CLI_MAIN);
  let out = '';
  child.stdout?.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => (out += chunk.toString('utf8')));
  child.stderr?.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => (out += chunk.toString('utf8')));
  const exited = new Promise<number | null>((resolve) => child.once('exit', (code) => resolve(code)));
  let gone = false;
  void exited.then(() => (gone = true));
  await waitUntil(() => out.includes('Press Ctrl-C to stop sharing.') || gone, 120_000, `smurg host ${folder} to share`);
  if (gone) throw new Error(`smurg host ${folder} ended:\n${out}`);
  const links = [...out.matchAll(/https?:\/\/\S+\/join\/(ws_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)#\S+/g)];
  const hostLink = links[0]?.[0] ?? '';
  const teammatesLink = links[1]?.[0] ?? '';
  const workspaceId = links[0]?.[1] ?? '';
  if (hostLink === '' || teammatesLink === '') throw new Error(`no links in:\n${out}`);
  const hostRun: HostRun = { folder, args, child, hostLink, teammatesLink, workspaceId, out: () => out, exited };
  runs.push(hostRun);
  starts.push({ folder, args: [...args], hostLink, teammatesLink, out });
  note(`smurg host ${folder} ${extraArgs.join(' ')}: ${workspaceId}`);
  return hostRun;
}

/** `smurg stop --workspace <id>` and the end of its `smurg host`. */
async function stopHost(hostRun: HostRun): Promise<string> {
  const stopped = await smurg(['stop', '--workspace', hostRun.workspaceId]);
  if (stopped.code !== 0) throw new Error(`smurg stop: ${stopped.out}`);
  await Promise.race([hostRun.exited, new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 60_000))]);
  if (hostRun.child.exitCode === null) throw new Error('smurg host did not end after smurg stop');
  runs.splice(runs.indexOf(hostRun), 1);
  note(`smurg stop ${hostRun.workspaceId}: ${stopped.out.trim().split('\n').join(' / ')}`);
  return stopped.out;
}

/** git in a folder, with the isolated configuration the story's repositories are made with. */
async function git(args: readonly string[], cwd = P.project): Promise<string> {
  return (await run('git', [...args], { cwd, env: isolatedGitEnv(P.gitHome), maxBuffer: 16 * MIB })).stdout.trim();
}

/** A person's device: a relay login, a device key and pins in files (`devices/<label>/`, the command's format). */
interface Device extends StackDevice {
  readonly label: string;
  readonly dir: string;
}
const devices = new Map<string, Device>();
const sessions = new Map<string, Promise<DevSession>>();
const loginOf = (login: string, displayName: string): Promise<DevSession> => {
  let session = sessions.get(login);
  if (session === undefined) {
    session = relay.devLogin(login, { displayName });
    sessions.set(login, session);
  }
  return session;
};
const capital = (name: string): string => name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.slice(1);

async function deviceOf(label: string, login = label.replace(/-\d+$/, ''), displayName = capital(login)): Promise<Device> {
  const existing = devices.get(label);
  if (existing !== undefined) return existing;
  const dir = join(P.devices, label);
  await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
  const key = await loadOrCreateCliDeviceKey(dir);
  const session = await loginOf(login, displayName);
  const device: Device = {
    label,
    dir,
    name: label,
    session,
    api: new RelayApi({ relayUrl: relay.origin, auth: { kind: 'bearer', token: session.token } }),
    deviceKeys: staticDeviceKeyProvider(key.keyPair) as StackDevice['deviceKeys'],
    pins: filePinStore(dir) as StackDevice['pins'],
  };
  devices.set(label, device);
  return device;
}

const clients: { close(): void }[] = [];

/** A connection of a device to a workspace, with an invite link or (null) its pin. */
async function connect(device: Device, workspaceId: string, invite: string | null, waitOnline = true): Promise<StackClient> {
  const parsed = invite === null ? null : parseInviteUrl(invite);
  const conn = new Connection({
    relay: device.api,
    workspaceId,
    deviceKeys: device.deviceKeys,
    pins: device.pins,
    invite: parsed ? { fingerprint: parsed.fingerprint, secret: parsed.secret } : null,
    clientKind: 'web',
    deviceName: `${device.label.replace(/-\d+$/, '')} browser`,
    backoff: TEST_BACKOFF,
  });
  const states: { at: number; state: ConnectionState }[] = [{ at: Date.now(), state: conn.getState() }];
  conn.subscribe((state) => states.push({ at: Date.now(), state }));
  clients.push(conn);
  const client: StackClient = {
    name: device.label,
    userId: device.session.userId,
    device,
    conn,
    states,
    get welcome(): Welcome | null {
      return conn.welcome;
    },
    waitFor: (predicate, timeoutMs = 15_000) => waitForState(conn, predicate, { timeoutMs }),
    reconnect: async (more = {}) => connect(device, workspaceId, more.invite === undefined ? null : more.invite, more.waitOnline ?? true),
    transfer: async () => {
      const transfer = new TransferConnection({ relay: device.api, workspaceId, deviceKeys: device.deviceKeys, pins: device.pins, clientKind: 'web', deviceName: `${device.label} transfer`, backoff: TEST_BACKOFF });
      clients.push(transfer);
      transfer.start();
      await transfer.whenOnline({ timeoutMs: 15_000 });
      return transfer;
    },
    close: () => conn.close(),
  };
  conn.start();
  if (waitOnline) await conn.whenOnline({ timeoutMs: 30_000 });
  return client;
}

/** UTF-8 bytes of a text. */
const bytes = (text: string): Uint8Array => new TextEncoder().encode(text);
const CHUNK = 1_048_576;
/** The transfer sockets of people, by label. */
const transfers: Record<string, TransferConnection | undefined> = {};

/** An upload through the transfer socket, every chunk, committed. */
async function uploadWhole(xfer: TransferConnection, file: FileRef, data: Uint8Array): Promise<void> {
  const begin = await xfer.request('file.upload.begin', { root: file.root, path: file.path, size: data.byteLength, chunkSize: CHUNK, lastModified: Date.now() });
  const hashes: Uint8Array[] = [];
  for (let index = 0; index * CHUNK < data.byteLength; index++) {
    const chunk = data.subarray(index * CHUNK, (index + 1) * CHUNK);
    const hash = new Uint8Array(createHash('sha256').update(chunk).digest());
    hashes.push(hash);
    await xfer.request('file.upload.chunk', { uploadId: begin.uploadId, index, hash, data: chunk });
  }
  await xfer.request('file.upload.commit', { uploadId: begin.uploadId, rootHash: uploadRootHash(data.byteLength, CHUNK, hashes) });
}

const uploadsLedger: { path: string; root?: unknown; uploadId: string; size: number; chunkSize: number; chunkCount: number; chunksSent: number[]; onConflict: string }[] = [];
/** An upload that is begun and left: only the chunks `sent` arrive (the rest of the file stays zeros in its part). */
async function uploadInterrupted(xfer: TransferConnection, file: FileRef, size: number, sent: readonly number[], onConflict: 'fail' | 'overwrite' | 'rename'): Promise<void> {
  const begin = await xfer.request('file.upload.begin', { root: file.root, path: file.path, size, chunkSize: CHUNK, lastModified: Date.now(), onConflict });
  const chunkCount = Math.ceil(size / CHUNK);
  for (const index of sent) {
    const length = Math.min(CHUNK, size - index * CHUNK);
    const chunk = Buffer.alloc(length, 'U');
    await xfer.request('file.upload.chunk', { uploadId: begin.uploadId, index, hash: new Uint8Array(createHash('sha256').update(chunk).digest()), data: chunk });
  }
  uploadsLedger.push({ path: file.path, ...(file.root.kind === 'main' ? {} : { root: file.root }), uploadId: begin.uploadId, size, chunkSize: CHUNK, chunkCount, chunksSent: [...sent], onConflict });
  ledger['uploads'] = { interrupted: uploadsLedger };
}

/** The documents people have open in the editor (kept open: what they typed stays theirs). */
const docs: DocClient[] = [];
async function openDoc(conn: Connection, file: FileRef): Promise<DocClient> {
  const doc = await DocClient.open(conn, file);
  docs.push(doc);
  await waitUntil(() => doc.synced, 15_000, `the editor of ${file.path}`);
  return doc;
}
/** Waits until a person's lock holds the file (the daemon takes it at the first update). */
async function humanLock(file: FileRef): Promise<void> {
  await waitUntil(async () => (await host.conn.request('lock.list', {})).locks.some((lock) => lock.kind === 'human' && lock.file.path === file.path && JSON.stringify(lock.file.root) === JSON.stringify(file.root)), 15_000, `a person's lock on ${file.path}`);
}
/** Every payload of one type a connection receives from now on. */
function recorded(conn: Connection, type: 'doc.conflict'): unknown[] {
  const seen: unknown[] = [];
  conn.on(type, (payload) => seen.push(payload));
  return seen;
}

/** The web address of the relay under another name (the last `smurg host` prints its links with it). */
let webOrigin = '';
/** From when the last reports wait for a review (their escalation is counted from there). */
let waitFrom = 0;
/** When the last question and request of the Bookshop were asked (they escalate after the host's minute). */
let lastAsk = 0;
/** "Claude Code was updated": the stand-in's file is replaced (its version is read again by every later start). */
async function replaceClaude(): Promise<void> {
  const text = await readFile(claude.path, 'utf8');
  await writeFile(claude.path, `${text}# replaced ${Date.now()}\n`);
  await chmod(claude.path, 0o755);
}

/**
 * Kills the agent process of one session as a crash would (SIGKILL): only a process of the story whose command line
 * names that session's launch file (`<SMURG_HOME>/sessions/<workspace key>/<hex of the session id>/settings.json`).
 */
async function killAgentOf(sessionId: string): Promise<number> {
  const mark = `/${Buffer.from(sessionId, 'utf8').toString('hex')}/settings.json`;
  let killed = 0;
  for (const line of await processesOfTheStory()) {
    if (!line.includes(mark) || !line.includes(P.host)) continue;
    const pid = Number.parseInt(line.trim().split(/\s+/)[0] ?? '', 10);
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(pid) || pid <= 1 || pid === process.pid) continue;
    process.kill(pid, 'SIGKILL');
    killed += 1;
  }
  return killed;
}

/** The final state of a connection that must not get in. */
async function refusedState(device: Device, workspaceId: string, invite: string | null): Promise<ConnectionState> {
  const client = await connect(device, workspaceId, invite, false);
  try {
    return await client.waitFor((state) => state.kind === 'rejected' || state.kind === 'closed' || state.kind === 'online', 30_000);
  } finally {
    client.close();
  }
}

/** Every process whose command line names ROOT (the story's daemons, their agents, terminals and hooks). */
async function processesOfTheStory(): Promise<string[]> {
  const { stdout } = await run('ps', ['-axo', 'pid=,command='], { maxBuffer: 16 * MIB });
  return stdout.split('\n').filter((line) => ROOT !== '' && line.includes(ROOT) && !line.includes('ps -axo'));
}

// =====================================================================================================================
// The pictures of the disk, and the fixture made from them (test/fixtures/published/README.md says what each file is)
// =====================================================================================================================

const PLACEHOLDER = '/__SMURG_FIXTURE__';
const pictures: Record<string, number> = {};

/** A picture of what smurg left: the host's SMURG_HOME, the command member's, the devices' (files and folders, no sockets). */
async function picture(name: 'running' | 'stopped'): Promise<void> {
  const at = Date.now();
  const to = join(OUT, 'raw', name);
  const copyTree = async (from: string, into: string): Promise<void> => {
    const st = await lstat(from).catch(() => null);
    if (st === null) return;
    if (st.isDirectory()) {
      await mkdir(into, { recursive: true });
      await chmod(into, st.mode & 0o777);
      for (const entry of (await readdir(from)).sort()) await copyTree(join(from, entry), join(into, entry));
      return;
    }
    if (st.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error(`a symbolic link in a picture: ${from} -> ${await readlink(from)}`);
    if (!st.isFile()) return; // a socket (run/*.lk, *.ctl, *.hook) is no file
    await writeFile(into, await readFile(from));
    await chmod(into, st.mode & 0o777);
  };
  await copyTree(P.host, join(to, 'host'));
  await copyTree(P.cliMember, join(to, 'cli-member'));
  await copyTree(P.devices, join(to, 'devices'));
  pictures[name] = at;
  note(`picture ${name} at ${at}`);
}

/** The texts of this computer that stand in the stored files, and what the fixture has in their place. */
function replacements(): [string, string][] {
  const short = hostname().replace(/\.local$/, '');
  return [
    [TREE, `${PLACEHOLDER}/smurg-src`],
    [process.execPath, `${PLACEHOLDER}/node`],
    [ROOT, PLACEHOLDER],
    [hostname(), 'fixture-host'],
    [short, 'fixture-host'],
  ];
}

interface StoredFile {
  path: string;
  mode: string;
  size: number;
  sha256: string;
  placeholder?: true;
  prefixOf?: string;
  pieces?: { offset: number; length: number; file: string }[];
}

/** Every folder and file below `dir` (relative paths, sorted). */
async function treeOf(dir: string): Promise<{ dirs: { path: string; mode: string }[]; files: { path: string; mode: string }[] }> {
  const dirs: { path: string; mode: string }[] = [];
  const files: { path: string; mode: string }[] = [];
  const walk = async (path: string, rel: string): Promise<void> => {
    for (const entry of (await readdir(path)).sort()) {
      const full = join(path, entry);
      const relPath = rel === '' ? entry : `${rel}/${entry}`;
      const st = await lstat(full);
      const mode = `0${(st.mode & 0o777).toString(8)}`;
      if (st.isDirectory()) {
        dirs.push({ path: relPath, mode });
        await walk(full, relPath);
      } else files.push({ path: relPath, mode });
    }
  };
  await walk(dir, '');
  return { dirs, files };
}

const sha256 = (bytes: Uint8Array): string => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');

/** The replaced bytes of a stored file, and how many of each replacement it holds. */
function replaced(bytes: Buffer, counts: Map<string, Set<string>>, path: string): { bytes: Buffer; placeholder: boolean } {
  let text = bytes.toString('latin1');
  let placeholder = false;
  for (const [from, to] of replacements()) {
    if (from === '' || !text.includes(from)) continue;
    text = text.split(from).join(to);
    if (to.startsWith(PLACEHOLDER)) placeholder = true;
    const files = counts.get(to) ?? new Set<string>();
    files.add(path);
    counts.set(to, files);
  }
  return { bytes: Buffer.from(text, 'latin1'), placeholder };
}

/** files.json, the stored files of both variants (running: what differs from stopped), from the raw pictures. */
async function writeFiles(fixture: string): Promise<{ counts: Map<string, Set<string>>; manifest: Record<string, unknown> }> {
  const counts = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const raw = join(OUT, 'raw');
  const stored: Record<string, Map<string, Buffer>> = {};
  const variants: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
  for (const name of ['stopped', 'running'] as const) {
    const tree = await treeOf(join(raw, name));
    const files: StoredFile[] = [];
    const mine = new Map<string, Buffer>();
    stored[name] = mine;
    const absent: string[] = [];
    for (const file of tree.files) {
      const original = await readFile(join(raw, name, file.path));
      const { bytes, placeholder } = replaced(original, counts, `${name}/${file.path}`);
      mine.set(file.path, bytes);
      const below = name === 'running' ? stored['stopped']?.get(file.path) : undefined;
      if (below !== undefined && below.equals(bytes)) continue; // the same as stopped: not stored twice
      const entry: StoredFile = { path: file.path, mode: file.mode, size: bytes.length, sha256: sha256(bytes) };
      if (placeholder) entry.placeholder = true;
      if (below !== undefined && bytes.length < below.length && below.subarray(0, bytes.length).equals(bytes)) {
        // A log that only grew between the two pictures: the first `size` bytes of stopped's.
        entry.prefixOf = 'stopped';
        entry.sha256 = sha256(bytes);
        if (!bytes.toString('latin1').includes(PLACEHOLDER)) delete entry.placeholder;
        files.push(entry);
        continue;
      }
      if (file.path.endsWith('.part')) {
        // An upload's part: the bytes that arrived at their offsets (the rest is zeros).
        const pieces: { offset: number; length: number; file: string }[] = [];
        let at = 0;
        while (at < bytes.length) {
          while (at < bytes.length && bytes[at] === 0) at += 1;
          if (at >= bytes.length) break;
          const start = at;
          let zeros = 0;
          while (at < bytes.length && zeros < 4096) {
            zeros = bytes[at] === 0 ? zeros + 1 : 0;
            at += 1;
          }
          const end = at - zeros;
          const pieceFile = `${file.path}.piece-${start}`;
          pieces.push({ offset: start, length: end - start, file: pieceFile });
          await mkdir(dirname(join(fixture, name, pieceFile)), { recursive: true });
          await writeFile(join(fixture, name, pieceFile), bytes.subarray(start, end));
        }
        files.push({ ...entry, pieces });
        continue;
      }
      await mkdir(dirname(join(fixture, name, file.path)), { recursive: true });
      await writeFile(join(fixture, name, file.path), bytes);
      files.push(entry);
    }
    if (name === 'running') for (const path of stored['stopped']?.keys() ?? []) if (!mine.has(path)) absent.push(path);
    variants[name] = { at: pictures[name] ?? 0, ...(name === 'running' ? { overlayOf: 'stopped', absent } : {}), dirs: tree.dirs, files };
  }
  const manifest = { version: '0.6.0', placeholder: PLACEHOLDER, variants };
  await writeFile(join(fixture, 'files.json'), `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`);
  return { counts, manifest };
}

// ---- coverage.json: the walk of test/upgrade/walker.ts over the persisted kinds of test/upgrade/persisted.ts -------

type CoverageModule = typeof import('../../../packages/daemon/test/upgrade/walker.ts');
type PersistedModule = typeof import('../../../packages/daemon/test/upgrade/persisted.ts');

interface EnumWalk {
  readonly enums: Map<string, { values: unknown[]; seen: Set<unknown> }>;
  readonly booleans: Map<string, Set<boolean>>;
}
const defOf = (schema: unknown): { type: string; [key: string]: unknown } | undefined => (schema as { _zod?: { def?: { type: string } } } | undefined)?._zod?.def as never;
/** The enumerations and booleans of a schema by path (union branches share their path), and what values visit. */
function declareEnums(schema: unknown, path: string, walk: EnumWalk, stack = new Set<unknown>()): void {
  const def = defOf(schema);
  if (!def || stack.has(schema)) return;
  stack.add(schema);
  try {
    switch (def.type) {
      case 'object':
        for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(def['shape'] as Record<string, unknown>)) declareEnums(child, path === '' ? key : `${path}.${key}`, walk, stack);
        break;
      case 'array':
        declareEnums(def['element'], `${path}[]`, walk, stack);
        break;
      case 'record':
        declareEnums(def['valueType'], `${path}{}`, walk, stack);
        break;
      case 'union':
        for (const option of def['options'] as unknown[]) declareEnums(option, path, walk, stack);
        break;
      case 'intersection':
        declareEnums(def['left'], path, walk, stack);
        declareEnums(def['right'], path, walk, stack);
        break;
      case 'pipe':
        declareEnums(def['in'], path, walk, stack);
        break;
      case 'lazy':
        declareEnums((def['getter'] as () => unknown)(), path, walk, stack);
        break;
      case 'optional':
      case 'nullable':
      case 'readonly':
      case 'nonoptional':
        declareEnums(def['innerType'], path, walk, stack);
        break;
      case 'enum': {
        const values = Object.values(def['entries'] as Record<string, unknown>);
        const entry = walk.enums.get(path) ?? { values: [], seen: new Set<unknown>() };
        for (const value of values) if (!entry.values.includes(value)) entry.values.push(value);
        walk.enums.set(path, entry);
        break;
      }
      case 'boolean':
        if (!walk.booleans.has(path)) walk.booleans.set(path, new Set());
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  } finally {
    stack.delete(schema);
  }
}
function visitEnums(schema: unknown, value: unknown, path: string, walk: EnumWalk, depth = 0): void {
  const def = defOf(schema);
  if (!def || depth > 200 || value === undefined) return;
  switch (def.type) {
    case 'object':
      if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object') return;
      for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(def['shape'] as Record<string, unknown>)) visitEnums(child, (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key], path === '' ? key : `${path}.${key}`, walk, depth + 1);
      break;
    case 'array':
      if (Array.isArray(value)) for (const item of value) visitEnums(def['element'], item, `${path}[]`, walk, depth + 1);
      break;
    case 'record':
      if (value !== null && typeof value === 'object') for (const item of Object.values(value)) visitEnums(def['valueType'], item, `${path}{}`, walk, depth + 1);
      break;
    case 'union': {
      const options = def['options'] as { safeParse(v: unknown): { success: boolean } }[];
      const chosen = options.find((option) => option.safeParse(value).success);
      if (chosen) visitEnums(chosen, value, path, walk, depth + 1);
      break;
    }
    case 'intersection':
      visitEnums(def['left'], value, path, walk, depth + 1);
      visitEnums(def['right'], value, path, walk, depth + 1);
      break;
    case 'pipe':
      visitEnums(def['in'], value, path, walk, depth + 1);
      break;
    case 'lazy':
      visitEnums((def['getter'] as () => unknown)(), value, path, walk, depth + 1);
      break;
    case 'optional':
    case 'nullable':
    case 'readonly':
    case 'nonoptional':
      if (value !== null) visitEnums(def['innerType'], value, path, walk, depth + 1);
      break;
    case 'enum':
      walk.enums.get(path)?.seen.add(value);
      break;
    case 'boolean':
      if (typeof value === 'boolean') walk.booleans.get(path)?.add(value);
      break;
    default:
      break;
  }
}

/** The schema each kind is an instance of, as the fixtures of 0.5.x name it (file and name in the tag's tree). */
const SCHEMA_NAMES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  'agent-sessions.json': 'packages/daemon/src/sessions/agent/store.ts documentSchema (not exported)',
  'cards.json': 'packages/daemon/src/conversation/cards-store.ts cardsIndexSchema (not exported)',
  'claude-trust.json': 'packages/daemon/src/sessions/agent/project-settings.ts documentSchema (not exported)',
  'conflicts.json': 'packages/daemon/src/docs/conflicts.ts conflictsDocumentSchema (not exported)',
  'host-rules.json': 'packages/daemon/src/sessions/agent/host-rules.ts documentSchema (not exported)',
  'inbox.json': 'packages/daemon/src/inbox/store.ts inboxDocumentSchema',

  'state.json.before-upgrade-from-0.4.0': 'packages/daemon/src/frozen/v0.4.0.ts stateShapeV040 (the shape the step from 0.4.0 of state.json reads: packages/daemon/src/core/workspace-state.ts)',
  'state.json.before-upgrade-from-0.5.0': 'packages/daemon/src/frozen/v0.5.0.ts stateShapeV050 (the shape the step from 0.5.0 of state.json reads: packages/daemon/src/core/workspace-state.ts)',
  'suggestions.json.before-upgrade-from-0.4.0': 'packages/daemon/src/frozen/v0.4.0.ts suggestionsShapeV040 (the shape the step from 0.4.0 of suggestions.json reads: packages/daemon/src/suggest/store.ts)',
  'transcripts/<hex of the session id>/cards.json': 'packages/daemon/src/conversation/cards-store.ts cardsFileSchema',
  'transcripts/<hex of the session id>/events-<6 digits>.jsonl': 'packages/protocol/src/schema/conversation.ts conversationEventSchema; the line: packages/daemon/src/sessions/agent/transcript.ts lineOf / parseLine',
  'uploads/<upload id>.json': 'packages/daemon/src/files/upload-store.ts manifestSchema',

  'audit-text.jsonl': 'none in the code (packages/daemon/src/core/audit-text.ts writes { sha256, at, text } and reads `text` back by its hash); described in coverage.json',
  'activity.jsonl': 'packages/protocol/src/schema/entities.ts activityEventSchema (read by packages/daemon/src/locks/activity-log.ts)',
  'identity.key': 'packages/protocol/src/node (loadOrCreateDaemonIdentity)',
  'conflicts/<hex of the conflict id>.bin': 'none (bytes; packages/daemon/src/docs/conflicts.ts)',
  'workspaces.json': 'none in the code: packages/cli/src/state/workspaces.ts reads it field by field (loadWorkspaces); described in coverage.json',
  'credentials.json': 'none in the code: packages/cli/src/state/credentials.ts reads it field by field (loadCredentials); described in coverage.json',
  'device.key': 'packages/protocol/src/node (loadOrCreateCliDeviceKey, pinDaemonKey)',
  'logs/<workspace id>.log': 'none (packages/cli/src/commands/host.ts openLog; packages/daemon/src/core/logger.ts)',
  'run/<12 characters>.pid': 'none (packages/daemon/src/local (the control module))',
  'sessions/<workspace key>/<hex of the session id>/settings.json, mcp.json, role.md': 'none (packages/daemon/src/hooks/settings-writer.ts)',
  'transcripts/<hex of the session id>/role.md': 'none (packages/daemon/src/sessions/agent (the agent runner))',
};
const schemaNameOf = (kind: string): string => {
  const key = Object.keys(SCHEMA_NAMES).filter((candidate) => kind === candidate || kind.startsWith(`${candidate}[`) || kind.startsWith(`${candidate} `) || kind.startsWith(`${candidate},`)).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)[0];
  if (key === undefined) throw new Error(`no schema name for the kind ${kind}`);
  return SCHEMA_NAMES[key] as string;
};

/** coverage.json from the raw pictures (both variants count together), with the reasons of REASONS for what is not visited. */
async function writeCoverage(fixture: string): Promise<{ gaps: string[]; totals: Record<string, { visited: number; notVisited: number }>; kinds: { kind: string; instances: number }[] }> {
  const walker = (await import('../../../packages/daemon/test/upgrade/walker.ts')) as CoverageModule;
  const persisted = (await import('../../../packages/daemon/test/upgrade/persisted.ts')) as PersistedModule;
  const raw = join(OUT, 'raw');
  const homes = [
    { label: 'stopped/host', variant: 'stopped', dir: join(raw, 'stopped', 'host'), home: 'host', prefix: 'host' },
    { label: 'running/host', variant: 'running', dir: join(raw, 'running', 'host'), home: 'host', prefix: 'host' },
    { label: 'cli-member', variant: 'stopped', dir: join(raw, 'stopped', 'cli-member'), home: 'member', prefix: 'cli-member' },
    ...(await readdir(join(raw, 'stopped', 'devices'))).sort().map((label) => ({ label: `devices/${label}`, variant: 'stopped', dir: join(raw, 'stopped', 'devices', label), home: 'device', prefix: `devices/${label}` })),
  ];
  const listed = await Promise.all(homes.map(async (home) => ({ ...home, files: existsSync(home.dir) ? (await treeOf(home.dir)).files.map((file) => file.path) : [] })));
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const gaps: string[] = [];
  const totals = { optionalKeys: { visited: 0, notVisited: 0 }, arrays: { visited: 0, notVisited: 0 }, records: { visited: 0, notVisited: 0 }, branches: { visited: 0, notVisited: 0 } };
  const kinds: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
  for (const kind of persisted.persistedKinds()) {
    const schema = kind.schema('0.6.0');
    const cov = walker.newCoverage();
    const enumWalk: EnumWalk = { enums: new Map(), booleans: new Map() };
    if (schema) {
      walker.declare(schema.schema, '', cov);
      declareEnums(schema.schema, '', enumWalk);
    }
    let instances = 0;
    const files: Record<string, string[]> = { stopped: [], running: [] };
    for (const home of listed) {
      if (!kind.homes.includes(home.home as 'host')) continue;
      for (const rel of home.files) {
        if (!kind.pattern.test(rel)) continue;
        seen.add(`${home.label}/${rel}`);
        files[home.variant]?.push(`${home.prefix}/${rel}`);
        const bytes = await readFile(join(home.dir, rel));
        const values = kind.read(bytes);
        for (const [index, value] of values.entries()) {
          instances += 1;
          if (!schema) continue;
          const parsed = schema.schema.safeParse(value);
          if (!parsed.success) {
            gaps.push(`REFUSED ${home.label}/${rel}${values.length > 1 ? ` line ${index + 1}` : ''}: ${parsed.error.issues.slice(0, 3).map((issue) => `${issue.path.join('.')}: ${issue.message}`).join('; ')}`);
            continue;
          }
          walker.visit(schema.schema, value, '', cov);
          visitEnums(schema.schema, value, '', enumWalk);
        }
        for (const problem of kind.problems?.(bytes) ?? []) gaps.push(`PROBLEM ${home.label}/${rel}: ${problem}`);
      }
    }
    if (instances === 0) continue;
    const entry: Record<string, unknown> = { kind: kind.kind, schema: schemaNameOf(kind.kind), instances, files };
    if (schema) {
      const report = walker.report(cov);
      for (const part of walker.COVERAGE_PARTS) {
        const notVisited = report[part].notVisited.map((at) => {
          const reason = REASONS[kind.kind]?.[at] ?? REASONS['*']?.[at];
          if (reason === undefined) gaps.push(`GAP ${kind.kind} | ${part} | ${at}`);
          return { at, why: reason?.why ?? 'not-made', reason: reason?.reason ?? 'NO REASON YET' };
        });
        entry[part] = { visited: report[part].visited, notVisited };
        totals[part].visited += report[part].visited.length;
        totals[part].notVisited += notVisited.length;
      }
      entry['optionalKeysNeverAbsent'] = [...cov.optional.entries()].filter(([, count]) => count.present > 0 && count.absent === 0).map(([path]) => path).sort();
      const enums: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      for (const [path, { values, seen: hit }] of [...enumWalk.enums.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))) {
        const visited = values.filter((value) => hit.has(value)).map(String).sort();
        const notVisited = values.filter((value) => !hit.has(value)).map(String).sort();
        const reason = ENUM_REASONS[kind.kind]?.[path];
        enums[path] = { visited, notVisited, ...(notVisited.length > 0 ? { why: reason?.why ?? 'not-made', reason: reason?.reason ?? ENUM_REASON_DEFAULT } : {}) };
      }
      entry['enums'] = enums;
      entry['booleans'] = Object.fromEntries([...enumWalk.booleans.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1)).map(([path, hit]) => [path, [...hit].sort().reverse().map(String)]));
    }
    kinds.push(entry);
  }
  for (const home of listed) for (const rel of home.files) if (!seen.has(`${home.label}/${rel}`)) gaps.push(`OF NO KIND ${home.label}/${rel}`);
  const coverage = {
    version: '0.6.0',
    what: 'What the files of this fixture are instances of, in the code of tag v0.6.0, and what of those schemas they visit. Made by the fixture\'s driver (packages/daemon/test/fixtures/drivers/fixture-driver-0.6.0.ts.txt, writeCoverage: the walk of test/upgrade/walker.ts and the persisted kinds of test/upgrade/persisted.ts, with the stamp and the kept copies as kinds) running in a git archive of the tag; see README.md.',
    howToRead: {
      paths: 'members[].avatarUrl = a key of every element of an array; members{}.seen{} = a value of a record; notes[]<kind=mention>.anchor = inside one branch of a union (a discriminated one by its key, another one by <index:what it is>); responsible<null> / responsible<value> = the two sides of a nullable.',
      visited: 'optionalKeys: present in at least one instance. arrays, records: not empty in at least one instance. branches: taken by at least one instance. enums: the values that occur.',
      variants: 'Both variants count together (stopped, running): every file of each copy is an instance.',
      why: '"cannot": the code of this version has no way to write it (the reason names the code). "not-made": it can be written, and this fixture does not hold it (the reason says what it would take).',
      enums: 'Every value of an enumeration that a stored file may hold. The ones that are not visited carry one reason for the whole enumeration; they are told for the reader and are not a gap of shape.',
    },
    documentsOpenedByTheDaemon: persisted.documentsOfThisSmurg().map((document) => document.name).sort(),
    totals,
    kinds,
  };
  await writeFile(join(fixture, 'coverage.json'), `${JSON.stringify(coverage, null, 2)}\n`);
  return { gaps, totals, kinds: kinds.map((kind) => ({ kind: String(kind['kind']), instances: Number(kind['instances']) })) };
}

/** Why a point of a schema is not visited, by kind and path. Each reason names the code (`cannot`) or what it would take. */
const REASONS: Record<string, Record<string, { why: 'cannot' | 'not-made'; reason: string }>> = (() => {
  const cannot = (reason: string) => ({ why: 'cannot' as const, reason });
  const notMade = (reason: string) => ({ why: 'not-made' as const, reason });
  const BOOLEAN =
    'The catalog of this version (packages/protocol/src/i18n/messages/*.ts) has a boolean parameter in two messages only, both of the activity feed (`activity.lockDeniedHeld.holderIsAgent`, `activity.fileCreate.isDir`: activity.ts:81 and :92); no text that is stored here is one of them.';
  const MENTION_TARGET =
    "A stored mention always points at a session: storeMentions has three callers (packages/daemon/src/suggest/suggestion-service.ts:267, conversation/messages.ts:91, conversation/questions.ts:165) and InboxService.addMention two more (hooks/mcp-tools.ts:330, conversation/questions.ts:267), every one with target { kind: 'session' }. The other targets of the column schema are for inbox items the daemon derives (inbox/derive.ts), which are not stored.";
  const RESULT_FROM =
    'A result note is stored by SuggestionService.tellAuthor (packages/daemon/src/suggest/suggestion-service.ts:500), called only from the accept and the reject of a person (lines 368 and 385): `from` is that person.';
  const REPORT_ERROR =
    'The error of a registered report is the first finding of the report format: `report.error.format` or `report.error.outcome`, both with the one parameter `line: number` (packages/protocol/src/i18n/messages/topics.ts:215-222; packages/daemon/src/topics/report-service.ts:244).';
  const START_LIST =
    "A start that fails stores the text of the error that stopped it (packages/daemon/src/topics/scheduler.ts, disarm: `plan.item.disarmed.changed`, `plan.item.disarmed.starter { name }`, or the error of the session, the worktree or the direct start). The catalog texts with a list parameter are the five `merge.*` refusals (packages/protocol/src/i18n/messages/worktrees.ts:327-343), raised by a merge; `file.lockedByPeople` (files.ts:71), raised by a person's write; `plan.error.cycle` and `report.changes.markers`, about a plan and a report; `conversation.locked.spec` and `permission.fileBusy`, written into a conversation and a card. None is an error a start raises.";
  const WARNINGS =
    'A plan has two warnings, `plan.warning.overlap { first, second }` and `plan.warning.noSummary { number }`: numbers only (packages/daemon/src/topics/plan-format.ts:343-355).';
  const LINE_LIST =
    'A conversation stores as a line one of the `conversation.*` texts or `session.resume.lost` (the lineEvent calls of packages/daemon/src); none of them takes a list. The one conversation text with a list, `conversation.locked.spec { holders }`, is stored as a notice (it is in this fixture).';
  const PENDING_STAMP =
    '`pending` is in the stamp only between an upgrade\'s first and last write (packages/daemon/src/core/workspace-folder.ts, phase 2: the stamp with `pending`, then each kept copy and its document, then the stamp without it): a kill there is unfinished.test\'s case (packages/daemon/test/upgrade/unfinished.test.ts). The pictures are of a smurg that runs and of one that stopped cleanly.';
  const KEPT_052 =
    "A kept copy of this kind here is agent-sessions.json of the 0.5.2 fixture as the step from 0.5.0 found it: the tree's own copyPublishedFixture('0.5.2', 'stopped') put that fixture's two workspaces into the host's home and the tree's daemon upgraded them (DESIGN 0.7.0 D1 (b); S0 runs no published executable and downloads nothing). That is the picture after `smurg stop`, where no message waits for a turn: what waited was dropped when 0.5.2's daemon stopped (the 0.5.2 fixture's README, \"What it holds\"). It would take the `running` picture of the 0.5.2 fixture, opened by this code as one more workspace.";
  const KEPT_040 =
    "A kept copy of this kind here is a file of the 0.4.0 fixture as the step from 0.4.0 found it, carried by the 0.5.2 fixture's second workspace (its README) and copied with the tree's own copy step (DESIGN 0.7.0 D1 (b)). That fixture was made once, with the published 0.4.0 executable (W/REAL, 2026-10-07), and is kept as it is";
  const pendingKept = Object.fromEntries(
    ['sessions[].pending', 'sessions[].pending[].turn.by', 'sessions[].pending[].turn.from', 'sessions[].pending[].turn.origin', 'sessions[].pending[].turn.purpose', 'sessions[].pending[].turn.suggestionId', 'sessions[].pending[].fromUserId<null>', 'sessions[].pending[].fromUserId<value>'].map((at) => [at, notMade(KEPT_052)]),
  );
  return {
    'inbox.json': {
      'members{}.notes[]<kind=mention>.from<kind=system>': cannot(
        'A mention is stored for the principal who wrote it: a person (a message, a suggestion, a comment, a reminder) or an agent (the notify_member tool). The system writes none: the five callers of InboxService.addMention pass principal.actor (packages/daemon/src/conversation/messages.ts:91, suggest/suggestion-service.ts:267 and conversation/questions.ts:165 through storeMentions; hooks/mcp-tools.ts:330; conversation/questions.ts:267).',
      ),
      ...Object.fromEntries(['changes', 'console', 'plan', 'report', 'spec'].map((kind) => [`members{}.notes[]<kind=mention>.target<kind=${kind}>`, cannot(MENTION_TARGET)])),
      'members{}.notes[]<kind=result>.from<kind=agent>': cannot(RESULT_FROM),
      'members{}.notes[]<kind=result>.from<kind=system>': cannot(RESULT_FROM),
    },
    'reports.json': {
      'reports[].error.text.params{}<0:string>': cannot(REPORT_ERROR),
      'reports[].error.text.params{}<2:boolean>': cannot(REPORT_ERROR),
      'reports[].error.text.params{}<3:array<string>>': cannot(REPORT_ERROR),
    },
    'topics.json': {

const ENUM_REASON_DEFAULT = 'The values that are not visited did not occur in the story this fixture was made with (the README lists what it holds).';

/** The fixture: files.json, the stored files, coverage.json, ledger.json; and what the README needs, in OUT. */
async function writeFixture(): Promise<void> {
  const fixture = join(OUT, 'fixture');
  await mkdir(fixture, { recursive: true });
  const { counts } = await writeFiles(fixture);
  const coverage = await writeCoverage(fixture);
  // `starts`: the links every `smurg host` printed, in order (of all four folders), as the 0.5.x ledgers have them.
  const printed = starts.map(({ folder, args, hostLink, teammatesLink }) => ({ folder, args, hostLink, teammatesLink }));
  const ledgerText = replacements().reduce((text, [from, to]) => (from === '' ? text : text.split(from).join(to)), JSON.stringify({ ...ledger, starts: printed, runningAt: pictures['running'], stoppedAt: pictures['stopped'] }, null, 2));
  await writeFile(join(fixture, 'ledger.json'), `${ledgerText}\n`);
  await writeFile(join(OUT, 'gaps.txt'), `${coverage.gaps.join('\n')}\n`);
  await writeFile(join(OUT, 'summary.json'), `${JSON.stringify({ replaced: Object.fromEntries([...counts.entries()].map(([to, files]) => [to, files.size])), totals: coverage.totals, kinds: coverage.kinds, pictures }, null, 2)}\n`);
  note(`fixture written: ${coverage.gaps.length} gaps`);
}

function report(itemId: string, title: string, outcome: 'complete' | 'partial' | 'blocked', extra = '', options: { followUps?: string; note?: string } = {}): string {
  return [
    `# Result report: ${title}`,
    '',
    `<!-- smurg:report v1 item=${itemId} -->`,
    `- outcome: ${outcome}`,
    '',
    '## What was done',
    `The work of ${title}.${extra}`,
    '',
    '## Why it was done this way',
    'As the spec decided.',
    '',
    '## How it was verified',
    `- [x] \`pnpm test\`: 3 tests passed${options.note === undefined ? '' : ` (${options.note})`}`,
    ...(outcome !== 'complete' ? ['- [ ] Manual check in the browser: not verified: no browser in this session'] : []),
    '',
    '## What to watch out for',
    outcome === 'complete' ? 'Nothing special.' : 'The page was never opened in a browser.',
    '',
    ...(options.followUps === undefined ? [] : ['## Follow-ups', options.followUps, '']),
  ].join('\n');
}
const reportSteps = (slug: string, itemId: string, title: string, outcome: 'complete' | 'partial' | 'blocked', extra = '', options: { followUps?: string; note?: string } = {}): FakeClaudeStep[] => [
  { tool: 'Write', input: { file_path: reportPath(slug, itemId), content: report(itemId, title, outcome, extra, options) } },
  { tool: 'mcp__smurg__check_report', input: {} },
  { text: `${title} is done.` },
];

/** A long conversation of two blocks of about 150 KiB (the 0.5.x fixtures kept it at two blocks). */
const LONG_BLOCKS = 2;
const LONG_BLOCK_CHARS = 150 * 1024;
function longBlock(index: number): string {
  const lines: string[] = [`Notes, part ${index + 1} of ${LONG_BLOCKS}. ${index === 0 ? M.longNotes : ''}`];
  let size = lines[0]?.length ?? 0;
  for (let line = 0; size < LONG_BLOCK_CHARS; line++) {
    const text = `Part ${index + 1}, line ${line}: the checkout keeps the cart, the payment and the receipt on one page.`;
    lines.push(text);
    size += text.length + 1;
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

/** A text of about `chars` characters made of one sentence. */
function longText(head: string, chars: number): string {
  const sentence = ' The balance of every card is kept to the cent.';
  return `${head}${sentence.repeat(Math.ceil(chars / sentence.length))}`.slice(0, chars);
}

/** A PLAN.md of one topic (the format of packages/daemon/src/topics/plan-format.ts). */
interface PlannedItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly touches: string;
  readonly dependsOn?: string;
  readonly size?: 's' | 'm' | 'l';
  /** No description: a warning of the plan. */
  readonly bare?: true;
}
function planText(title: string, items: readonly PlannedItem[], intro = `${items.length} work items.`): string {
  return [
    `# Plan: ${title}`,
    '',
    intro,
    '',
    '<!-- smurg:plan v1 -->',
    '',
    ...items.flatMap((item, index) => [
      `### ${index + 1}. ${item.title}`,
      `- id: ${item.id}`,
      ...(item.dependsOn === undefined ? [] : [`- depends on: ${item.dependsOn}`]),
      `- size: ${item.size ?? 's'}`,
      `- touches: ${item.touches}`,
      '',
      ...(item.bare === true ? [] : [`Do ${item.title.toLowerCase()}. Done when its tests pass.`, '']),
    ]),
    '<!-- smurg:plan end -->',
    '',
  ].join('\n');
}
function specText(title: string, goal: string): string {
  return [`# ${title}`, '', '## Goal', goal, '', '## Decisions', '- Keep it small.', '', '## Out of scope', 'Everything else.', '', '## Open questions', 'None.', ''].join('\n');
}

/** A topic of run 5: its first message, its spec and its plan (or a plan that does not parse, and no fix). */
function smallTopicTurns(slug: string, title: string, first: string, plan: string | null, fix?: string): Turn[] {
  return [
    { match: first.replace(/[.?]/g, '\\$&'), once: true, steps: [{ tool: 'Write', input: { file_path: `specs/${slug}/SPEC.md`, content: specText(title, first) } }, { text: 'Spec ready.' }] },
    ...(plan === null ? [] : [{ match: `Write specs/${slug}/PLAN\\.md`, steps: [{ tool: 'Write', input: { file_path: `specs/${slug}/PLAN.md`, content: plan } }, { tool: 'mcp__smurg__check_plan', input: {} }, { text: 'A plan.' }] } as Turn]),
    ...(fix === undefined ? [] : [{ match: `smurg cannot use "specs/${slug}/PLAN\\.md"`, steps: [{ text: fix }] } as Turn]),
  ];
}

/** What the "model" does: the tree's story, and whatever the chapter adds in front of it. */
function scenario(): FakeClaudeScenario {
  return {
    ...(hostRulesOn ? { rules: HOST_RULES } : {}),
    ...(accountNow === undefined ? {} : { account: accountNow }),
    ...scenarioExtra,
    turns: [
      ...extraTurns,
      // ---- the discussion
      { match: 'one page', once: true, steps: [{ tool: 'AskUserQuestion', input: { questions: [PAYMENT] } }, { tool: 'Write', input: { file_path: SPEC_PATH, content: SPEC } }, { text: `The first draft of the spec is ready. ${M.agentText}` }] },
      { match: 'coupons', steps: [{ tool: 'Edit', input: { file_path: SPEC_PATH, old_string: 'Invoices.', new_string: 'Invoices. Coupons.' } }, { text: 'Coupons are out of scope now.' }] },
      { match: 'Write specs/checkout/PLAN\\.md', steps: [{ tool: 'Write', input: { file_path: PLAN_PATH, content: PLAN } }, { tool: 'mcp__smurg__check_plan', input: {} }, { text: 'The plan has three work items.' }] },
      // ---- work item 1: edits in its worktree, then a command that asks (and waits for a person)
      {
        match: 'Start work item 1 \\(id cart-api\\)',
        steps: [
          { tool: 'Write', input: { file_path: 'src/cart/total.ts', content: 'export const total = (prices: number[]): number => prices.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);\n' } },
          { tool: 'Edit', input: { file_path: 'src/app.ts', old_string: APP_BEFORE, new_string: APP_BY_CART } },
          PNPM_TEST,
          ...reportSteps(SLUG, 'cart-api', 'Cart API', 'partial', ` ${M.report}`),
        ],
      },
      // ---- work item 2 (starts when 1 is merged): the same kind of command is not asked any more
      { match: 'Start work item 2 \\(id checkout-page\\)', steps: [PNPM_TEST, { tool: 'Write', input: { file_path: 'src/checkout/page.ts', content: 'export const page = "checkout";\n' } }, ...reportSteps(SLUG, 'checkout-page', 'Checkout page', 'complete')] },
      // ---- work item 3: stops without a report, twice
      { match: 'Start work item 3 \\(id receipt-email\\)', steps: [{ tool: 'Edit', input: { file_path: 'src/app.ts', old_string: APP_BEFORE, new_string: APP_BY_RECEIPT } }, { text: 'I changed the title.' }] },
      { match: 'You stopped without the result report', steps: [{ text: 'I am not sure what is missing.' }] },
      { match: 'Continue the work item', steps: onContinue },
      { match: 'conflict markers', steps: [{ tool: 'Write', input: { file_path: 'src/app.ts', content: APP_RESOLVED } }, ...reportSteps(SLUG, 'receipt-email', 'Receipt email', 'complete', ' The title names both now.')] },
      { steps: [{ text: 'ok' }] },
    ],
  };
}

/** The run of `smurg host` of (a) that is sharing now. */
let A: HostRun;

let host: Member;
