/** An invite of the host, made through `admin.invite.create` (the real E2E path), kept in the ledger by its label. */
async function invite(label: string | null, role: GuestRole, options: { maxUses?: number; expiresInSec?: number } = {}): Promise<string> {
  const reply = await host.conn.request('admin.invite.create', { role, ...(options.maxUses === undefined ? {} : { maxUses: options.maxUses }), ...(options.expiresInSec === undefined ? {} : { expiresInSec: options.expiresInSec }) });
  if (label !== null) ledger.invites[label] = { url: reply.url, id: reply.invite.id, role, ...options, createdAt: reply.invite.createdAt, ...(reply.invite.expiresAt === undefined ? {} : { expiresAt: reply.invite.expiresAt }) };
  return reply.url;
}

/** A person joins (a) with a link: a member who holds what they are sent. */
async function enter(label: string, role: string, link: string | null, displayName?: string): Promise<Member> {
  const device = await deviceOf(label, undefined, displayName);
  const client = await connect(device, WS, link);
  const one = member(client, displayName ?? capital(label.replace(/-\d+$/, '')), role as Member['role']);
  await one.sync();
  return one;
}

let failed = false;
/** For making the driver: SMURG_FX_STOP_AFTER=<n> runs the first n steps of the story, then the pictures and the fixture. */
const STOP_AFTER = Number.parseInt(process.env['SMURG_FX_STOP_AFTER'] ?? '1000', 10);
let stepCount = 0;
const step = (title: string, body: () => Promise<void>, timeoutMs = 600_000, final = false): void => {
  stepCount += 1;
  const skipped = !final && stepCount > STOP_AFTER;
  (skipped ? it.skip : it)(title, { timeout: timeoutMs }, async () => {
    if (!final) expect(failed, 'an earlier step of the story failed: this one cannot run on its own').toBe(false);
    const before = failed;
    failed = true;
    note(`step: ${title}`);
    await body();
    note(`done: ${title}`);
    failed = before;
  });
};

describe('the fixture of smurg 0.6.0, made by the code of the tag', { timeout: 3_600_000 }, () => {
  beforeAll(async () => {
    if (OUT === '') throw new Error('SMURG_FX_OUT must name the folder the fixture is written to');
    mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true });
    ROOT = await createTempRunDir();
    note(`ROOT ${ROOT} TREE ${TREE} node ${process.execPath}`);
    for (const dir of [P.home, P.host, P.cache, P.claudeDir, P.devices, P.gitHome, P.outside]) await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    await writeFile(join(P.outside, 'secret.txt'), 'outside the share\n');
    idp = await startMockIdp();
    relay = await startLocalRelay({ tap: false, vars: { ...idp.vars }, secrets: { ...idp.secrets } });
    note(`relay ${relay.origin} idp ${idp.base}`);
    onContinue = CART_GOES_ON;
    claude = await installFakeClaude(P.claudeDir, scenario());
  }, 300_000);

  afterAll(async () => {
    for (const doc of docs.splice(0)) doc.destroy();
    for (const client of clients.splice(0)) {
      try {
        client.close();
      } catch {
        // closed already
      }
    }
    for (const hostRun of [...runs]) await stopHost(hostRun).catch((err: unknown) => note(`stop on the way out: ${String(err)}`));
    await relay?.stop();
    await idp?.close();
    const left = await processesOfTheStory().catch(() => []);
    note(`processes left: ${left.length}`);
    if (ROOT !== '' && process.env['SMURG_FX_KEEP_ROOT'] !== '1') await removeTempRunDir(ROOT);
  }, 300_000);

  step('the host logs in and shares the folder once: the workspace, credentials.json, workspaces.json, the host log', async () => {
    await mkdir(P.project, { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(join(P.project, 'README.md'), '# Bookshop\n');
    await mkdir(join(P.project, 'src'), { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(join(P.project, 'src', 'app.ts'), APP_BEFORE);
    await run('git', ['init', '-q', '-b', 'main'], { cwd: P.project, env: isolatedGitEnv(P.gitHome) });
    await git(['add', '-A']);
    await git(['commit', '-q', '-m', 'initial']);
    const login = await smurg(['login', '--relay', relay.origin, '--dev-user', 'host']);
    expect(login.code, login.out).toBe(0);
    A = await smurgHost(P.project, ['--name', 'Bookshop', '--role', 'editor']);
    WS = A.workspaceId;
    ledger['workspaceId'] = WS;
    ledger['relay'] = relay.origin;
    ledger['firstRun'] = { hostLink: A.hostLink, teammatesLink: A.teammatesLink, note: 'printed by the first `smurg host`; the host link was never used and is revoked by the next start, the teammates\' link (editor, 7 days, no use limit) was used later' };
    const status = await smurg(['status']);
    ledger['statusFirstRun'] = status.out;
    await stopHost(A);
  });

  step('the tree\'s story, part 1: a topic from its creation to its plan (a question with votes and a comment, the spec, a revision an Editor asked for, the plan), with its model and mode chosen by a person', async () => {
    A = await smurgHost(P.project, ['--name', 'Bookshop', '--role', 'editor']);
    ledger['story'] = { startedAt: Date.now(), hostLink: A.hostLink, note: 'the host link of the start the tree\'s story began with: used by the host\'s own device (devices/host)' };
    host = await enter('host', 'host', A.hostLink, 'Host');
    ledger['settingsBefore'] = (await host.conn.request('admin.settings.get', {})).settings;
    await host.conn.request('admin.settings.set', { maxLiveAgents: 8 });
    const storyInvites: { url: string; role: string; for: string }[] = [];
    const storyJoin = async (label: string, role: GuestRole): Promise<Member> => {
      const url = await invite(null, role, { maxUses: 1 });
      storyInvites.push({ url, role, for: label });
      return enter(label, role, url);
    };
    mei = await storyJoin('mei', 'agent');
    amy = await storyJoin('amy', 'editor');
    leo = await storyJoin('leo', 'viewer');
    ledger['storyInvites'] = storyInvites;
    const everyone = (): Member[] => [host, mei, amy, leo];

    expect((await amy.conn.request('topic.create', { name: 'Mine' }).catch((err: unknown) => err)) as object).toMatchObject({ code: 'forbidden' });
    const created = await mei.conn.request('topic.create', { name: 'Checkout', firstMessage: `We want the checkout on one page. ${M.toAgent}` });
    topicId = created.topic.id;
    discussionId = created.session.id;
    for (const one of everyone()) await one.watch(discussionId);
    // 0.6.0: Mei chooses the model and the mode of the topic's sessions (the workspace is in auto mode, 0.6.0's default).
    await waitUntil(async () => (await mei.conn.request('topic.agent.set', { topicId, model: 'sonnet', permissionMode: 'ask-commands' }).then(() => true, () => false)), 30_000, 'the topic\'s agent settings to be accepted (the host\'s model list known)');

    const payment = await questionAt(leo, (question) => question.sessionId === discussionId && question.status === 'open', 'the question of the discussion');
    expect((await leo.conn.request('question.vote', { questionId: payment.id, part: 0, options: [0] }).catch((err: unknown) => err)) as object).toMatchObject({ code: 'forbidden' });
    await host.conn.request('question.vote', { questionId: payment.id, part: 0, options: [0] });
    await amy.conn.request('question.vote', { questionId: payment.id, part: 0, options: [1] });
    const { commentId } = await amy.conn.request('question.comment', { questionId: payment.id, text: `@Leo invoices matter to schools. ${M.comment}`, mentions: [leo.userId] });
    for (const one of everyone()) await questionAt(one, (question) => question.id === payment.id && question.votes.length === 2 && question.comments.some((comment) => comment.id === commentId), 'both votes and the comment');
    await inboxItem(leo, (item) => item.kind === 'mention', 'the mention');
    await mei.conn.request('question.submit', { questionId: payment.id, answers: [{ options: [0] }], note: `Keep it simple. ${M.note}` });
    await turnsFinished(leo, discussionId, 1);
    await statusIs(leo, discussionId, 'idle');
    await topicIs(leo, topicId, (topic) => topic.phase === 'spec', 'the first draft');

    const revise = await amy.conn.request('topic.revise', { topicId, target: 'spec', text: `Please say that coupons are not part of it. ${M.suggestion}` });
    if (!('suggestion' in revise)) throw new Error("an Editor's revise must be a suggestion");
    await suggestionAt(mei, (suggestion) => suggestion.id === revise.suggestion.id && suggestion.status === 'pending', 'the suggestion card');
    await mei.conn.request('suggest.accept', { suggestionId: revise.suggestion.id });
    await turnsFinished(leo, discussionId, 2);
    await statusIs(leo, discussionId, 'idle');

    await mei.conn.request('plan.generate', { topicId });
    await turnsFinished(leo, discussionId, 3);
    await statusIs(leo, discussionId, 'idle');
    await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => plan.items.length === 3, 'the plan');
    await mei.conn.request('plan.assign', { topicId, itemId: 'cart-api', userId: mei.userId });
    await mei.conn.request('plan.assign', { topicId, itemId: 'checkout-page', userId: amy.userId });
    await mei.conn.request('plan.assign', { topicId, itemId: 'receipt-email', userId: host.userId });
    await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'receipt-email')?.responsible?.userId === host.userId, 'who is responsible');
  });

  step('the tree\'s story, part 2: Start; a permission card, an item that stops without a report and a pending suggestion; Mei reloads, Noa joins late; a long conversation', async () => {
    const everyone = (): Member[] => [host, mei, amy, leo];
    const { preflight } = await mei.conn.request('plan.preflight', { topicId });
    expect(preflight).toMatchObject({ startsNow: ['cart-api', 'receipt-email'], blockers: [] });
    const started = (await mei.conn.request('plan.start', { topicId, planRevision: preflight.planRevision, specHash: preflight.specHash, planHash: preflight.planHash })).plan;
    cartId = itemOf(started, 'cart-api')?.sessionId as string;
    receiptId = itemOf(started, 'receipt-email')?.sessionId as string;
    for (const one of everyone()) for (const id of [cartId, receiptId]) await one.watch(id);
    const asked = await permissionAt(leo, (request) => request.sessionId === cartId && request.status === 'open', 'the command of work item 1');
    cartRequestId = asked.id;
    await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'receipt-email')?.state === 'stalled', 'work item 3 stalled');
    await turnsFinished(leo, receiptId, 2);
    const { suggestion } = await amy.conn.request('suggest.create', { sessionId: discussionId, text: 'Please also think of gift cards.' });
    amySuggestionId = suggestion.id;
    await suggestionAt(mei, (held) => held.id === suggestion.id && held.status === 'pending', "Amy's suggestion");
    const keys = (await mei.inbox()).map((item) => item.key);
    mei.conn.notify('inbox.seen', { keys });
    await waitUntil(async () => (await mei.inbox()).every((item) => !item.unread), 10_000, "Mei's inbox to be read");

    // Mei reloads the page (the pinned key, no invite); Noa joins.
    mei.client.close();
    mei = member(await mei.client.reconnect(), 'Mei', 'agent');
    await mei.sync();
    for (const id of [discussionId, cartId, receiptId]) await mei.watch(id);
    const noaUrl = await invite(null, 'agent', { maxUses: 1 });
    (ledger['storyInvites'] as { url: string; role: string; for: string }[]).push({ url: noaUrl, role: 'agent', for: 'noa' });
    noa = await enter('noa', 'agent', noaUrl);
    for (const id of [discussionId, cartId, receiptId]) await noa.watch(id);

    // A long conversation (two blocks of 150 KiB), in a free session of Mei's.
    const { session } = await mei.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Notes' });
    notesId = session.id;
    await sessionReady(host, notesId);
    for (const one of [host, mei, amy, leo]) await one.watch(notesId);
    extraTurns = [{ match: 'long notes', steps: Array.from({ length: LONG_BLOCKS }, (_, index) => ({ text: longBlock(index) })) }];
    await setScenario();
    await mei.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: notesId, text: 'Please write the long notes.' });
    await turnsFinished(leo, notesId, 1, 120_000);
    await statusIs(leo, notesId, 'idle');
    extraTurns = [];
    await setScenario();
    await noa.watch(notesId);
    await noa.readBack(notesId, 4);
  });

  step('the tree\'s story, part 3: the host\'s smurg stops and starts again (smurg stop, smurg host); "Continue all"', async () => {
    await stopHost(A);
    for (const one of [host, mei, amy, leo, noa]) await one.client.waitFor((state) => state.kind === 'host-offline', 30_000);
    A = await smurgHost(P.project, ['--name', 'Bookshop', '--role', 'editor']);
    for (const one of [host, mei, amy, leo, noa]) await one.client.waitFor((state) => state.kind === 'online', 60_000);
    for (const one of [host, mei, amy, leo, noa]) await one.sync();
    await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => plan.paused === true, 'the paused plan');
    await inboxItem(mei, (item) => item.kind === 'attention' && item.subject === 'plan-paused', 'the paused plan');
    const resumed = (await mei.conn.request('plan.resume', { topicId })).plan;
    expect(resumed.paused).toBe(false);
    const askedAgain = await permissionAt(leo, (request) => request.sessionId === cartId && request.status === 'open' && request.id !== cartRequestId, 'the command, asked again');
    cartRequestId = askedAgain.id;
  });

  step('the tree\'s story, part 4: reports and reviews, merges by the host, a conflict the agent resolves, the topic complete', async () => {
    const members = [host, mei, amy, leo, noa];
    await mei.conn.request('permission.decide', { requestId: cartRequestId, decision: 'allow-always', scope: 'topic' });
    await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'cart-api')?.report?.state === 'to-review', 'the report of work item 1');
    const report1 = (await leo.conn.request('report.get', { topicId, itemId: 'cart-api' })).report;
    await mei.conn.request('report.review', { topicId, itemId: 'cart-api', version: 1, acknowledgeUnfinished: true });
    const cartDraft = report1.changes?.requestId as string;
    await inboxItem(host, (item) => item.key === `merge:${cartDraft}` && item.ready === true, 'the change to merge');
    expect((await host.conn.request('worktree.merge.approve', { requestId: cartDraft })).request).toMatchObject({ status: 'merged' });
    await statusIs(leo, cartId, 'ended');
    const running = await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'checkout-page')?.sessionId !== undefined, 'work item 2 started');
    pageId = itemOf(running, 'checkout-page')?.sessionId as string;
    for (const one of members) await one.watch(pageId);
    await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'checkout-page')?.report?.state === 'to-review', 'the report of work item 2');
    await amy.conn.request('report.review', { topicId, itemId: 'checkout-page', version: 1 });
    const pageDraft = (await leo.conn.request('report.get', { topicId, itemId: 'checkout-page' })).report.changes?.requestId as string;
    await inboxItem(host, (item) => item.key === `merge:${pageDraft}` && item.ready === true, 'the change of work item 2');
    expect((await host.conn.request('worktree.merge.approve', { requestId: pageDraft })).request).toMatchObject({ status: 'merged' });
    await statusIs(leo, pageId, 'ended');

    onContinue = RECEIPT_GOES_ON;
    await setScenario();
    await host.conn.request('plan.item.continue', { topicId, itemId: 'receipt-email' });
    await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'receipt-email')?.report?.state === 'to-review', 'the report of work item 3');
    await host.conn.request('report.review', { topicId, itemId: 'receipt-email', version: 1 });
    const receiptDraft = (await leo.conn.request('report.get', { topicId, itemId: 'receipt-email' })).report.changes?.requestId as string;
    expect((await host.conn.request('worktree.merge.approve', { requestId: receiptDraft })).request).toMatchObject({ status: 'conflict', conflictFiles: ['src/app.ts'] });
    await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'receipt-email')?.merge?.status === 'conflict', 'the conflict in the plan');
    await mei.conn.request('plan.item.resolve', { topicId, itemId: 'receipt-email' });
    await planIs(leo, topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'receipt-email')?.report?.version === 2, 'the report after the conflict was resolved');
    const resolved = (await leo.conn.request('report.get', { topicId, itemId: 'receipt-email' })).report;
    await host.conn.request('report.review', { topicId, itemId: 'receipt-email', version: 2 });
    const resolvedDraft = resolved.changes?.requestId as string;
    await inboxItem(host, (item) => item.key === `merge:${resolvedDraft}` && item.ready === true, 'the resolved change');
    expect((await host.conn.request('worktree.merge.approve', { requestId: resolvedDraft })).request).toMatchObject({ status: 'merged' });
    expect(await readFile(join(P.project, 'src', 'app.ts'), 'utf8')).toBe(APP_RESOLVED);
    await topicIs(leo, topicId, (topic) => topic.phase === 'complete', 'the complete topic');
    ledger['checkout'] = { topicId, discussionId, notesId, cartId, receiptId, pageId, suggestionLeftPending: amySuggestionId };
    onContinue = CART_GOES_ON;
    await setScenario();
  });

  // ==== Run 4: the Bookshop of the 0.5.x fixtures, from the start that prints a viewer link ===========================
  step('run 4: smurg host with a viewer link (30 days, 20 uses); the project\'s Claude Code settings, confirmed and ignored by the host; a settings change', async () => {
    // The project's own Claude Code files (committed: every worktree has them too) and what their commands point at.
    const files: Record<string, string> = {
      '.claude/settings.json': `${JSON.stringify({ hooks: { PostToolUse: [{ matcher: 'Edit', hooks: [{ type: 'command', command: 'sh scripts/lint.sh' }, { type: 'command', command: 'sh scripts/optional.sh' }] }] }, permissions: { allow: ['Read(docs/**)'] } }, null, 2)}\n`,
      '.claude/settings.local.json': `${JSON.stringify({ permissions: { allow: ['Bash(git status)'] } }, null, 2)}\n`,
      '.mcp.json': `${JSON.stringify({ mcpServers: { docs: { command: 'node', args: ['docs-server.js'] } } }, null, 2)}\n`,
      '.claude/agents/reviewer.md': '---\nname: reviewer\ndescription: Reviews a change.\n---\nRead the diff and say what is wrong.\n',
      'scripts/lint.sh': 'exit 0\n',
      'scripts/optional.sh': 'true\n',
      'docs-server.js': 'true\n',
      'data/prices.csv': 'title,price\nA book,12\n',
      '.gitignore': 'data/\n',
    };
    for (const [path, content] of Object.entries(files)) {
      await mkdir(dirname(join(P.project, path)), { recursive: true });
      await writeFile(join(P.project, path), content);
    }
    await git(['add', '-A']);
    await git(['commit', '-q', '-m', 'the project\'s Claude Code settings']);
    // Something Claude Code loads from the main folder's .claude/ that no worktree has (not committed).
    await mkdir(join(P.project, '.claude', 'commands'), { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(join(P.project, '.claude', 'commands', 'hello.md'), 'Say hello.\n');
    for (const one of [host, mei, amy, leo, noa]) one.client.close();
    await stopHost(A);
    A = await smurgHost(P.project, ['--name', 'Bookshop', '--role', 'viewer', '--expires', '30d', '--max-uses', '20']);
    host = member(await connect(await deviceOf('host', 'host', 'Host'), WS, null), 'Host', 'host');
    await host.sync();
    const config = (await host.conn.request('admin.claudeConfig.get', {})).roots;
    ledger['claudeConfigFirst'] = config.map((root) => ({ root: root.root, state: root.state, files: root.files.map((file) => ({ path: file.path, decision: file.decision })) }));
    const main = config.find((root) => root.root.kind === 'main');
    if (main === undefined) throw new Error('no project settings of the main folder');
    const decide = async (path: string, decision: 'trust' | 'ignore'): Promise<void> => {
      const file = main.files.find((candidate) => candidate.path === path);
      if (file === undefined) throw new Error(`no ${path} among the project settings`);
      await host.conn.request('admin.claudeConfig.decide', { root: main.root, files: [{ path, hash: file.hash }], decision, acknowledged: [...file.needsAck] });
    };
    await decide('.claude/settings.json', 'trust');
    await decide('.claude/settings.local.json', 'ignore');
    await decide('.mcp.json', 'ignore');
    // The settings the host chose (the console's settings form).
    await host.conn.request('admin.settings.set', { humanLockIdleMs: 45_000, uploadChunkSize: 1_048_576, sharedDirs: ['data'], diskReservePercent: 3, escalateAfterMs: 60_000 });
    ledger['settingsAfter'] = (await host.conn.request('admin.settings.get', {})).settings;
  });

  step('run 4: invite links of every state; members who join (a second device of Amy\'s through the first run\'s link), are turned away, are removed, come back on a new device, change role', async () => {
    await invite('bob-viewer-1use', 'viewer', { maxUses: 1 });
    await invite('kate-agent-1use', 'agent', { maxUses: 1 });
    await invite('dave-agent-1use', 'agent', { maxUses: 1 });
    await invite('ruth-agent-1use', 'agent', { maxUses: 1 });
    await invite('agents-3uses', 'agent', { maxUses: 3 });
    await invite('multi-editor-5uses', 'editor', { maxUses: 5 });
    await invite('gina-viewer-2uses-then-revoked', 'viewer', { maxUses: 2 });
    await invite('unused-editor-3uses', 'editor', { maxUses: 3 });
    await invite('unused-viewer-nolimit-30d', 'viewer', { expiresInSec: 30 * 86_400 });
    await invite('unused-agent-1use', 'agent', { maxUses: 1 });
    await invite('expired-editor-6s', 'editor', { maxUses: 2, expiresInSec: 6 });
    await invite('revoked-unused-editor', 'editor', { maxUses: 4 });
    await invite('cli-member-agent-1use', 'agent', { maxUses: 1 });
    const link = (label: string): string => ledger.invites[label]?.url as string;
    people.bob = await enter('bob', 'viewer', link('bob-viewer-1use'));
    people.kate = await enter('kate', 'agent', link('kate-agent-1use'));
    people.dave = await enter('dave', 'agent', link('dave-agent-1use'));
    people.ruth = await enter('ruth', 'agent', link('ruth-agent-1use'));
    people.pete = await enter('pete', 'agent', link('agents-3uses'));
    people.quinn = await enter('quinn', 'agent', link('agents-3uses'));
    people.erin = await enter('erin', 'editor', link('multi-editor-5uses'));
    people.olga = await enter('olga', 'editor', link('multi-editor-5uses'));
    people.frank = await enter('frank', 'editor', link('multi-editor-5uses'));
    people.gina = await enter('gina', 'viewer', link('gina-viewer-2uses-then-revoked'));
    // Amy on a second device, through the editor link the first `smurg host` printed (she is a member already).
    people.amy = await enter('amy-2', 'editor', (ledger['firstRun'] as { teammatesLink: string }).teammatesLink, 'Amy');
    // The people of the tree's story come back on their own devices (no link: their pins).
    people.mei = member(await connect(await deviceOf('mei'), WS, null), 'Mei', 'agent');
    people.leo = member(await connect(await deviceOf('leo'), WS, null), 'Leo', 'viewer');
    people.noa = member(await connect(await deviceOf('noa'), WS, null), 'Noa', 'agent');
    people.amyFirst = member(await connect(await deviceOf('amy'), WS, null), 'Amy', 'editor');
    for (const one of [people.mei, people.leo, people.noa, people.amyFirst]) await one?.sync();
    mei = people.mei as Member;
    amy = people.amy as Member;
    leo = people.leo as Member;
    noa = people.noa as Member;

    const refused: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    const stateOf = (state: ConnectionState): unknown => (state.kind === 'rejected' ? { kind: state.kind, reason: state.reason } : state.kind === 'closed' ? { kind: state.kind, reason: state.reason } : { kind: state.kind });
    refused['a used-up single-use link'] = stateOf(await refusedState(await deviceOf('mallory'), WS, link('bob-viewer-1use')));
    await host.conn.request('admin.invite.revoke', { inviteId: ledger.invites['revoked-unused-editor']?.id as string });
    await host.conn.request('admin.invite.revoke', { inviteId: ledger.invites['gina-viewer-2uses-then-revoked']?.id as string });
    (ledger.invites['revoked-unused-editor'] as { revoked?: boolean }).revoked = true;
    (ledger.invites['gina-viewer-2uses-then-revoked'] as { revoked?: boolean }).revoked = true;
    refused['a revoked link'] = stateOf(await refusedState(await deviceOf('mallory-2', 'mallory', 'Mallory'), WS, link('revoked-unused-editor')));
    await waitUntil(() => Date.now() > (ledger.invites['expired-editor-6s']?.expiresAt ?? 0) + 200, 20_000, 'the six seconds of a link');
    refused['an expired link'] = stateOf(await refusedState(await deviceOf('mallory-3', 'mallory', 'Mallory'), WS, link('expired-editor-6s')));
    // Frank is removed; his device stays out; he comes back on a new device with a new link.
    await host.conn.request('admin.member.kick', { userId: 'dev:frank' });
    await (people.frank as Member).client.waitFor((state) => state.kind === 'closed', 15_000);
    refused["a removed member's device, no link"] = stateOf(await refusedState(await deviceOf('frank'), WS, null));
    ledger['refused'] = refused;
    ledger['devicesRevoked'] = { 'frank (first device)': 'frank' };
    await invite('frank-editor-rejoin-1use', 'editor', { maxUses: 1 });
    people.frank = await enter('frank-2', 'editor', link('frank-editor-rejoin-1use'), 'Frank');
    // Gina becomes an Editor.
    await host.conn.request('admin.member.setRole', { userId: 'dev:gina', role: 'editor' });
    await (people.gina as Member).client.waitFor((state) => state.kind === 'online', 15_000);
    note(`members: ${(await host.conn.request('admin.member.list', {})).members.map((one) => `${one.userId} ${one.role}`).join(', ')}`);
  });

  step('run 4: files (create, write, rename, delete), refusals, an upload and a download, the editor, conflicts that are applied, dismissed and open (one with many hunks), the host frees a lock', async () => {
    const amyC = amy.conn;
    const main = (path: string) => ({ root: MAIN_ROOT, path });
    await amyC.request('file.create', { file: main('assets'), kind: 'dir' });
    await amyC.request('file.create', { file: main('draft.txt'), kind: 'file' });
    await amyC.request('file.write', { file: main('draft.txt'), content: bytes('a first draft') });
    await amyC.request('file.rename', { root: MAIN_ROOT, from: 'draft.txt', to: 'final.txt' });
    await amyC.request('file.delete', { file: main('final.txt') });
    await amyC.request('file.create', { file: main('docs'), kind: 'dir' });
    await amyC.request('file.create', { file: main('notes'), kind: 'dir' });
    await amyC.request('file.write', { file: main('notes/keep.md'), content: bytes('# Keep\nkeep\n') });
    await expect(leo.conn.request('file.write', { file: main('notes/leo.md'), content: bytes('no') })).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'forbidden' });
    await expect(amyC.request('admin.member.list', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: 'forbidden' });
    // An upload through the transfer socket, whole; a download.
    const xfer = await amy.client.transfer();
    transfers.amy = xfer;
    const logo = Buffer.alloc(2_000, 'L');
    await uploadWhole(xfer, main('assets/logo.txt'), logo);
    const download = await xfer.download({ file: main('README.md') }, { onChunk: () => {} });
    await download.done;
    // The editor: Amy types in the README.
    const readme = await openDoc(amyC, main('README.md'));
    readme.text.insert(0, '<!-- amy was here -->\n');
    await humanLock(main('README.md'));
    await waitUntil(async () => (await readFile(join(P.project, 'README.md'), 'utf8')).startsWith('<!-- amy'), 15_000, 'the autosave of the README');
    await amyC.request('lock.release', { file: main('README.md') });
    // Conflicts: someone types while another program rewrites the same line (attributed to the person who wrote the
    // file last when it comes within seconds of that write; to nobody later).
    const conflictsSeen = (conn: Connection): unknown[] => recorded(conn, 'doc.conflict');
    const typedThenRewritten = async (who: Member, path: string, first: string, typed: (doc: DocClient) => void, rewrite: string): Promise<string> => {
      await amyC.request('file.write', { file: main(path), content: bytes(first) });
      const seen = conflictsSeen(who.conn);
      const doc = await openDoc(who.conn, main(path));
      typed(doc);
      await humanLock(main(path));
      await writeFile(join(P.project, path), rewrite);
      await waitUntil(() => seen.length > 0, 20_000, `the conflict of ${path}`);
      return (seen[0] as { conflict: { id: string } }).conflict.id;
    };
    const open = await typedThenRewritten(amy, 'conflict.txt', 'line one\nline two\nline three\n', (doc) => doc.text.insert(4, ' (Amy)'), 'line ONE by a formatter\nline two\nline three\n');
    const applied = await typedThenRewritten(people.erin as Member, 'docs/plan.md', '# Plan\n\nThe plan of the shop.\n', (doc) => doc.text.insert(2, "Erin's "), '# PLAN (rewritten by a script)\n\nThe plan of the shop.\n');
    await (people.erin as Member).conn.request('doc.conflict.resolve', { conflictId: applied, action: 'apply-agent-version' });
    const dismissed = await typedThenRewritten(people.gina as Member, 'docs/gina.md', '# Gina\n\nnotes of gina\n', (doc) => doc.text.insert(2, 'About '), '# GINA (reformatted)\n\nnotes of gina\n');
    await (people.gina as Member).conn.request('doc.conflict.resolve', { conflictId: dismissed, action: 'dismiss' });
    const lines = Array.from({ length: 140 }, (_, index) => `line ${index + 1}`);
    const many = await typedThenRewritten(
      people.frank as Member,
      'docs/many.md',
      `${lines.join('\n')}\n`,
      (doc) => {
        for (let index = lines.length - 2; index >= 0; index -= 2) doc.text.insert(lines.slice(0, index).join('\n').length + (index === 0 ? 0 : 1), 'frank: ');
      },
      `${lines.map((line, index) => (index % 2 === 0 ? `${line.toUpperCase()} (a formatter)` : line)).join('\n')}\n`,
    );
    // The host frees a lock by force (Amy types in her notes).
    const keep = await openDoc(amyC, main('notes/keep.md'));
    keep.text.insert(0, '> ');
    await humanLock(main('notes/keep.md'));
    await host.conn.request('lock.forceRelease', { file: main('notes/keep.md') });
    // Others keep their editors open: the people's typing stays in their documents.
    ledger['conflicts'] = { open: { id: open, path: 'conflict.txt', for: 'dev:amy' }, applied, dismissed, openWithManyHunks: many };
  });

  step('run 4: terminals (ended by the restart, exited by itself, ended by the host); worktrees with merge requests of every outcome; a kept worktree; a removed one', async () => {
    const kate = people.kate as Member;
    const ruth = people.ruth as Member;
    const terminal = async (who: Member, workspace: { mode: 'main' } | { mode: 'worktree'; worktreeId?: string }, title?: string) => (await who.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'terminal', workspace, cols: 80, rows: 24, ...(title === undefined ? {} : { title }) })).session;
    const sessionsLedger: Record<string, string> = (ledger['sessions'] as Record<string, string> | undefined) ?? {};
    ledger['sessions'] = sessionsLedger;
    const worktreesLedger: Record<string, string> = {};
    ledger['worktrees'] = worktreesLedger;
    const mergesLedger: Record<string, string> = {};
    ledger['merges'] = mergesLedger;
    sessionsLedger['T1-host-terminal-ended-by-the-restart'] = (await terminal(host, { mode: 'main' })).id;
    const t2 = await terminal(kate, { mode: 'main' }, 'Kate exits');
    sessionsLedger['T2-kate-terminal-exited-by-itself'] = t2.id;
    kate.conn.notify('exec.input', { sessionId: t2.id, data: bytes('exit 0\n') });
    const t3 = await terminal(kate, { mode: 'main' }, 'Kate is stopped');
    sessionsLedger['T3-kate-terminal-ended-by-the-host'] = t3.id;
    await host.conn.request('admin.session.terminate', { sessionId: t3.id });
    // Ruth in a worktree: a merge that is approved, one that is rejected, one that waits.
    const w1 = await terminal(ruth, { mode: 'worktree' }, 'Ruth in a worktree');
    sessionsLedger['W1-ruth-terminal-in-a-worktree-ended-by-the-restart'] = w1.id;
    const w1Id = (w1.root as { worktreeId: string }).worktreeId;
    worktreesLedger['W1-ruth-kept-with-a-waiting-change'] = w1Id;
    const wt = (worktreeId: string, path: string) => ({ root: { kind: 'worktree' as const, worktreeId }, path });
    await ruth.conn.request('file.write', { file: wt(w1Id, 'feature.txt'), content: bytes('a new feature\n') });
    const { request: m1 } = await ruth.conn.request('worktree.merge.request', { worktreeId: w1Id, message: 'The new feature' });
    mergesLedger['free-merged'] = m1.id;
    expect((await host.conn.request('worktree.merge.approve', { requestId: m1.id })).request).toMatchObject({ status: 'merged' });
    await ruth.conn.request('file.write', { file: wt(w1Id, 'second.txt'), content: bytes('second\n') });
    const { request: m2 } = await ruth.conn.request('worktree.merge.request', { worktreeId: w1Id, message: 'A second file' });
    mergesLedger['free-rejected'] = m2.id;
    await host.conn.request('worktree.merge.reject', { requestId: m2.id, reason: 'Not yet, please.' });
    await ruth.conn.request('file.write', { file: wt(w1Id, 'third.txt'), content: bytes('a third file that waits\n') });
    const { request: m3 } = await ruth.conn.request('worktree.merge.request', { worktreeId: w1Id, message: 'A third file' });
    mergesLedger['free-pending'] = m3.id;
    // Kate in a worktree: her change conflicts with the main folder (a merge that fails), then she leaves it (kept).
    const w2 = await terminal(kate, { mode: 'worktree' }, 'Kate in a worktree');
    sessionsLedger['W2-kate-terminal-in-a-worktree-kept'] = w2.id;
    const w2Id = (w2.root as { worktreeId: string }).worktreeId;
    worktreesLedger['W2-kate-kept-no-session'] = w2Id;
    await kate.conn.request('file.write', { file: wt(w2Id, 'conflict.txt'), content: bytes('kate wrote this line instead\nline two\nline three\n') });
    await amy.conn.request('file.write', { file: { root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'notes/keep.md' }, content: bytes('# Keep\nkeep, said Amy in the main folder\n') }).catch(() => {});
    await kate.conn.request('file.create', { file: wt(w2Id, 'notes'), kind: 'dir' });
    await kate.conn.request('file.write', { file: wt(w2Id, 'notes/keep.md'), content: bytes('# Keep\nkeep, said Kate\n') });
    const { request: m4 } = await kate.conn.request('worktree.merge.request', { worktreeId: w2Id, message: 'Kate\'s notes' });
    mergesLedger['free-conflict'] = m4.id;
    const tried = await host.conn.request('worktree.merge.approve', { requestId: m4.id }).catch((err: unknown) => err);
    note(`kate's merge: ${JSON.stringify(tried).slice(0, 300)}`);
    // Kate types in the worktree's README while another program rewrites it there (a conflict in a worktree).
    const seen = recorded(kate.conn, 'doc.conflict');
    const readmeDoc = await openDoc(kate.conn, wt(w2Id, 'README.md'));
    readmeDoc.text.insert(0, 'kate types here ');
    await humanLock(wt(w2Id, 'README.md'));
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 7_000));
    await writeFile(join(P.project, '.smurg', 'worktrees', w2Id, 'README.md'), '# Bookshop (rewritten in the worktree)\n');
    await waitUntil(() => seen.length > 0, 20_000, 'the conflict in the worktree');
    (ledger['conflicts'] as Record<string, unknown>)['openInWorktree'] = (seen[0] as { conflict: { id: string } }).conflict.id;
    await kate.conn.request('session.end', { sessionId: w2.id, keepWorktree: true });
    // An interrupted upload into Kate's worktree (one chunk of two arrived).
    await kate.conn.request('file.create', { file: wt(w2Id, 'assets'), kind: 'dir' });
    await uploadInterrupted(transfers.amy as TransferConnection, wt(w2Id, 'assets/in-worktree.bin'), 1_048_606, [1], 'rename');
    // Ruth: a worktree she removes.
    const w3 = await terminal(ruth, { mode: 'worktree' }, 'Ruth removes it');
    sessionsLedger['W3-ruth-terminal-in-a-worktree-removed'] = w3.id;
    const w3Id = (w3.root as { worktreeId: string }).worktreeId;
    worktreesLedger['W3-ruth-removed'] = w3Id;
    await ruth.conn.request('session.end', { sessionId: w3.id, keepWorktree: true });
    await ruth.conn.request('worktree.remove', { worktreeId: w3Id });
    // Two more interrupted uploads into the main folder: one chunk of two, and none of one.
    await uploadInterrupted(transfers.amy as TransferConnection, { root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'assets/logo.txt' }, 1_048_907, [1], 'overwrite');
    await uploadInterrupted(transfers.amy as TransferConnection, { root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'assets/clip.bin' }, 1_022_710, [], 'fail');
  });

  step('run 4: the host\'s agent session "Look around" (asks before commands): tools of every kind, permission cards of every kind and every answer, turns that end badly, stopped turns, a member told, a locked file, a conflict the agent makes, the host\'s own rules, a personal subscription', async () => {
    const sessionsLedger = ledger['sessions'] as Record<string, string>;
    const kate = people.kate as Member;
    const bob = people.bob as Member;
    const gina = people.gina as Member;
    // What the host's own Claude Code allows (the rules every session reports), and a login of a personal plan.
    hostRulesOn = true;
    accountNow = { subscriptionType: 'Claude Max', apiProvider: 'firstParty' };
    extraTurns = A1_TURNS();
    await setScenario();
    const { session } = await host.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Look around', permissionMode: 'ask-commands' });
    const a1 = session.id;
    sessionsLedger['A1-host-agent-main'] = a1;
    await sessionReady(host, a1);
    for (const one of [host, mei, amy, kate]) await one.watch(a1);
    // ---- turn 1: reading, searching, a sub-agent, a fetch the host always allows here, a tool the session does not have
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a1, text: 'Please look around.' });
    const fetch = await permissionAt(host, (request) => request.sessionId === a1 && request.status === 'open', 'the fetch');
    await host.conn.request('permission.decide', { requestId: fetch.id, decision: 'allow-always' });
    await turnsFinished(host, a1, 1, 60_000);
    accountNow = undefined;
    await setScenario();
    // ---- the mode, chosen twice; the model (0.6.0: a person chose it)
    await host.conn.request('session.mode.set', { sessionId: a1, mode: 'ask-all' });
    await host.conn.request('session.mode.set', { sessionId: a1, mode: 'ask-commands' });
    await host.conn.request('session.model.set', { sessionId: a1, model: 'opus' });
    // ---- turn 2: commands, each answered differently
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a1, text: 'Please run the checks.' });
    const decide = async (what: string, decision: 'allow' | 'allow-always' | 'deny', by: Member = host, message?: string): Promise<void> => {
      const request = await permissionAt(host, (candidate) => candidate.sessionId === a1 && candidate.status === 'open', what);
      await by.conn.request('permission.decide', { requestId: request.id, decision, ...(message === undefined ? {} : { message }) });
      await waitUntil(() => host.permissions().find((candidate) => candidate.id === request.id)?.status !== 'open', 15_000, `${what} decided`);
    };
    await decide('pnpm test', 'allow');
    await decide('pnpm coverage', 'allow-always');
    await decide('make (one word: no rule to offer)', 'allow');
    await decide('rm -rf build', 'deny', host, 'Do not delete the build, please.');
    await decide('curl', 'deny', mei);
    await decide('the lint script', 'allow');
    await decide('the optional script', 'deny');
    await turnsFinished(host, a1, 2, 60_000);
    // ---- turns that end badly; turns that are stopped (by Mei, by the host)
    for (const [index, text] of ['Now end badly, please.', 'This will take too many turns.', 'This is too expensive.'].entries()) {
      await mei.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a1, text });
      await turnsFinished(host, a1, 3 + index, 30_000);
    }
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a1, text: 'Now wait for me.' });
    await waitUntil(() => host.events(a1).some((event) => event.kind === 'text' && event.text === 'Waiting.'), 20_000, 'the waiting turn');
    await mei.conn.request('session.interrupt', { sessionId: a1 });
    await turnsFinished(host, a1, 6, 30_000);
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a1, text: 'Please recite slowly.' });
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2_500));
    await host.conn.request('session.interrupt', { sessionId: a1 });
    await turnsFinished(host, a1, 7, 30_000);
    // ---- a member told by the agent (a mention from the agent in Bob's inbox)
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a1, text: '@Bob look at this: tell bob the notes are ready.', mentions: [bob.userId] });
    await turnsFinished(host, a1, 8, 30_000);
    // ---- a file people are typing in (Erin and Amy have docs/plan.md open): the agent's edit is refused
    const plan = await openDoc(amy.conn, { root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'docs/plan.md' });
    plan.text.insert(0, '');
    const planErin = await openDoc((people.erin as Member).conn, { root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'docs/plan.md' });
    planErin.text.insert(planErin.text.length, '\nErin adds a line.\n');
    await humanLock({ root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'docs/plan.md' });
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a1, text: 'Please change the plan doc.' });
    await turnsFinished(host, a1, 9, 30_000);
    // ---- Gina types in docs/gina.md while a command of the agent rewrites it; then the late notes
    const ginaDoc = await openDoc(gina.conn, { root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'docs/gina.md' });
    ginaDoc.text.insert(0, 'gina is typing ');
    await humanLock({ root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'docs/gina.md' });
    const ginaSeen = recorded(gina.conn, 'doc.conflict');
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a1, text: 'Please overwrite the notes with a command.' });
    await turnsFinished(host, a1, 10, 30_000);
    await waitUntil(() => ginaSeen.length > 0, 20_000, 'the conflict a command of the agent made');
    (ledger['conflicts'] as Record<string, unknown>)['openByAgent'] = (ginaSeen[0] as { conflict: { id: string } }).conflict.id;
    await writeFile(join(P.project, 'docs', 'late.md'), 'first line of the late notes\n');
    const late = await openDoc(gina.conn, { root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'docs/late.md' });
    late.text.insert(0, 'gina is typing ');
    await humanLock({ root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'docs/late.md' });
    const lateSeen = recorded(gina.conn, 'doc.conflict');
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a1, text: 'Please write the late notes.' });
    await turnsFinished(host, a1, 11, 30_000);
    await waitUntil(() => lateSeen.length > 0, 20_000, 'the conflict of the late notes');
    (ledger['conflicts'] as Record<string, unknown>)['openByTheAgentWithALongHunk'] = (lateSeen[0] as { conflict: { id: string } }).conflict.id;
    note(`A1 rules: ${JSON.stringify((await host.conn.request('session.rules.get', { sessionId: a1 })).rules.map((rule) => `${rule.tool} ${rule.pattern}`))}`);
  });

  step('run 4: suggestions of every origin and outcome in "Look around"; more sessions: ended by their owner, crashed, ended by the host, one very long answer, one in a worktree (its merge refused: host-only files); members who leave, are removed, change role, with their sessions', async () => {
    const sessionsLedger = ledger['sessions'] as Record<string, string>;
    const suggestionsLedger: Record<string, string> = {};
    ledger['suggestions'] = suggestionsLedger;

    await setScenario();

    const turnsOf = (sessionId: string): number => host.events(sessionId).filter((event) => event.kind === 'turn.finished').length;
    const accepted = async (sessionId: string, before: number): Promise<void> => {
      await turnsFinished(host, sessionId, before + 1, 30_000);
    };
    const s1 = await suggest(amy, a1, 'Please also count the folders.');
    await amy.conn.request('suggest.edit', { suggestionId: s1, text: 'Please also count the folders, edited.' });
    await amy.conn.request('suggest.withdraw', { suggestionId: s1 });
    suggestionsLedger['s1-amy-edited-then-withdrawn'] = s1;
    const s2 = await suggest(amy, a1, 'Please delete the old notes.');
    await host.conn.request('suggest.reject', { suggestionId: s2, reason: 'We keep them.' });
    suggestionsLedger['s2-amy-rejected-with-a-reason'] = s2;
    const s2b = await suggest(amy, a1, 'Please rename every file.');

    before = turnsOf(a1);
    const s5 = await suggest(amy, a1, 'tidy this up please, @Kate', { mentions: [kate.userId] });
    await host.conn.request('suggest.accept', { suggestionId: s5 });
    await accepted(a1, before);
    suggestionsLedger['s5-amy-accepted'] = s5;
    suggestionsLedger['s6-gina-pending'] = await suggest(gina, a1, 'Please add a page for gina.');

    suggestionsLedger['s8-olga-withdrawn-when-she-is-a-viewer'] = await suggest(olga, a1, 'Please add a page for olga.');

    // ---- A2: Kate's session, which she ends while it waits for her
    const { session: a2 } = await kate.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Short one', firstMessage: 'Hello.', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });

    await kate.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a2.id, text: 'Now ask once more, please.' });
    await questionAt(host, (question) => question.sessionId === a2.id && question.status === 'open', 'the question of A2');
    await kate.conn.request('session.interrupt', { sessionId: a2.id });
    await turnsFinished(host, a2.id, 3, 30_000);
    await kate.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a2.id, text: 'Please run something and wait.' });
    await permissionAt(host, (request) => request.sessionId === a2.id && request.status === 'open', 'the second command of A2');
    await kate.conn.request('session.end', { sessionId: a2.id });
    await statusIs(host, a2.id, 'ended');
    // ---- A3: the host's session whose agent crashes; A5: Kate's, ended by the host; A11: one very long answer
    const { session: a3 } = await host.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Crash', firstMessage: 'Please crash now.', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });
    sessionsLedger['A3-host-agent-crashed'] = a3.id;
    await host.watch(a3.id);
    await statusIs(host, a3.id, 'failed', 30_000);
    const { session: a5 } = await kate.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Terminated', firstMessage: 'Hello.', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });
    sessionsLedger['A5-kate-agent-ended-by-the-host'] = a5.id;
    await host.watch(a5.id);
    await turnsFinished(host, a5.id, 1, 30_000);

    await statusIs(host, a5.id, 'ended');
    const { session: a11 } = await kate.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Everything', firstMessage: 'Please recite everything you know.', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });
    sessionsLedger['A11-kate-agent-one-very-long-answer'] = a11.id;
    await host.watch(a11.id);
    await turnsFinished(host, a11.id, 1, 60_000);
    await kate.conn.request('session.end', { sessionId: a11.id });
    // ---- A4: Ruth's session in a worktree: a note, an edit she allows, a question she leaves; the worktree is kept
    const { session: a4 } = await ruth.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'worktree' }, title: 'In a worktree', firstMessage: 'Please write a note in the worktree.', permissionMode: 'ask-commands' });
    sessionsLedger['A4-ruth-agent-in-a-worktree-ended-kept'] = a4.id;
    const w4 = (a4.root as { worktreeId: string }).worktreeId;
    (ledger['worktrees'] as Record<string, string>)['W4-ruth-agent-kept'] = w4;
    await host.watch(a4.id);
    await turnsFinished(host, a4.id, 1, 30_000);
    await ruth.conn.request('session.mode.set', { sessionId: a4.id, mode: 'ask-all' });
    await ruth.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a4.id, text: 'Please change the note in the worktree.' });
    const edit = await permissionAt(host, (request) => request.sessionId === a4.id && request.status === 'open', 'the edit in the worktree');
    await ruth.conn.request('permission.decide', { requestId: edit.id, decision: 'allow' });
    await turnsFinished(host, a4.id, 2, 30_000);
    suggestionsLedger['s10-amy-in-a-worktree-rejected-when-the-session-ended'] = await suggest(amy, a4.id, 'Please write a second note.');
    await ruth.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a4.id, text: 'Now ask once more, please.' });
    await questionAt(host, (question) => question.sessionId === a4.id && question.status === 'open', 'the question in the worktree');
    await ruth.conn.request('session.end', { sessionId: a4.id, keepWorktree: true });
    await statusIs(host, a4.id, 'ended');
    // The host ignores the worktree's project settings and confirms what Claude Code loads from the main folder's .claude.
    const config = (await host.conn.request('admin.claudeConfig.get', {})).roots;
    for (const root of config) {
      if (root.root.kind === 'worktree') {
        const files = root.files.filter((file) => file.decision === null);
        if (files.length > 0) await host.conn.request('admin.claudeConfig.decide', { root: root.root, files: files.map((file) => ({ path: file.path, hash: file.hash })), decision: 'ignore', acknowledged: [] });
      } else {
        const loaded = root.files.find((file) => file.path === '.claude');
        if (loaded !== undefined && loaded.decision === null) await host.conn.request('admin.claudeConfig.decide', { root: root.root, files: [{ path: loaded.path, hash: loaded.hash }], decision: 'trust', acknowledged: [...loaded.needsAck] });
      }
    }
    ledger['claudeConfig'] = (await host.conn.request('admin.claudeConfig.get', {})).roots.map((root) => ({ root: root.root, state: root.state, files: root.files.map((file) => ({ path: file.path, decision: file.decision })) }));
    // In a terminal of that worktree Ruth writes a file only the host may change: the merge request is refused.
    const { session: w4Terminal } = await ruth.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'terminal', workspace: { mode: 'worktree', worktreeId: w4 }, cols: 80, rows: 24, title: 'Ruth in her agent\'s worktree' });
    ruth.conn.notify('exec.input', { sessionId: w4Terminal.id, data: bytes("printf '# Notes for Claude\\n' > CLAUDE.md; exit 0\n") });
    await waitUntil(() => existsSync(join(P.project, '.smurg', 'worktrees', w4, 'CLAUDE.md')), 15_000, 'the file Ruth wrote in her terminal');
    const refusedMerge = await ruth.conn.request('worktree.merge.request', { worktreeId: w4, message: 'The note' }).catch((err: unknown) => err);
    note(`ruth's merge of host-only files: ${JSON.stringify(refusedMerge).slice(0, 200)}`);

    // ---- Dave leaves (his sessions end with him); Pete is removed; Quinn becomes an Editor; Erin is removed; Olga a Viewer
    const dave = people.dave as Member;
    const { session: a6 } = await dave.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: "Dave's", firstMessage: 'Hello.', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });
    sessionsLedger['A6-dave-agent-ended-when-he-left'] = a6.id;
    await host.watch(a6.id);
    await turnsFinished(host, a6.id, 1, 30_000);
    const { session: t4 } = await dave.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'terminal', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, cols: 80, rows: 24 });
    sessionsLedger['T4-dave-terminal-ended-when-he-left'] = t4.id;
    await dave.conn.leave();
    ledger['left'] = { dave: 'dev:dave' };
    await statusIs(host, a6.id, 'ended');
    const pete = people.pete as Member;
    const { session: a7 } = await pete.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: "Pete's", firstMessage: 'Hello.', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });
    sessionsLedger['A7-pete-agent-ended-when-he-was-removed'] = a7.id;
    await host.watch(a7.id);

    await host.conn.request('admin.member.kick', { userId: 'dev:pete' });
    await statusIs(host, a7.id, 'ended');
    const quinn = people.quinn as Member;
    const { session: a8 } = await quinn.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: "Quinn's", firstMessage: 'Hello.', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });
    sessionsLedger['A8-quinn-agent-ended-when-her-role-changed'] = a8.id;
    await host.watch(a8.id);

    await host.conn.request('admin.member.setRole', { userId: 'dev:quinn', role: 'editor' });

    await host.conn.request('admin.member.kick', { userId: 'dev:erin' });
    await host.conn.request('admin.member.setRole', { userId: 'dev:olga', role: 'viewer' });
    ledger['kicked'] = { erin: 'dev:erin', pete: 'dev:pete' };
    ledger['roleChanged'] = { gina: 'viewer -> editor', quinn: 'agent -> editor', olga: 'editor -> viewer' };

  });

  step('run 4: the topic "Gift cards": a plan that does not parse, then seventeen work items started in three parts, that end differently (reports, follow-ups, a hand edit, an invalid report, conflicts, a merge the policy refuses, a snapshot that fails, agents that crash, stop or are stopped)', async () => {

    await waitUntil(async () => (await leo.conn.request('report.get', { topicId: gift, itemId: 'card-faq' })).report.state === 'invalid', 60_000, 'the FAQ report invalid');

    await planIs(leo, gift, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'card-banner')?.report?.version === 2, 'the banner\'s second version', 60_000);
    // ---- the page: follow-ups (one from an Editor, a suggestion), a long answer, a message while it works

    await turnsFinished(host, page, 2, 30_000);

    await mei.conn.request('report.followUp', { topicId: gift, itemId: 'card-page', text: `What about empty cards? Please check the gift card with the next number too. ${'Please be thorough. '.repeat(1_000)}` });

  // ==== Run 5: smurg stop and smurg host in the middle of "Gift cards" ===============================================
  step('run 5: smurg stop in the middle of "Gift cards", smurg host again with an agent link (2 days, 3 uses) and another web address; everyone comes back; the plan is paused; the question asked again; a revision of a spec someone is typing in', async () => {

  step('run 5: more topics: a start that fails (an old Claude Code), a starter who is removed, a spec deleted by hand, plans that do not parse, a discussion the host ended (lost), one that is started again and renamed, an archived topic, a deleted one; and "Wishlist", which is at work when the pictures are taken', async () => {
    const topicsLedger = ledger['topics'] as Record<string, unknown>;

    await host.conn.request('admin.member.kick', { userId: 'dev:sam' });
    (ledger['kicked'] as Record<string, string>)['sam'] = 'dev:sam';
    await planIs(leo, tiny.topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'tiny-two')?.disarmed === 'starter-removed', 'tiny two disarmed', 30_000);

    // ---- Exchange and Vouchers: plans that do not parse (an id twice; items that wait for each other)
    await specAndPlan(await create('Exchange', 'People want to exchange a book.'), 'invalid');
    const vouchers = await create('Vouchers', 'We sell vouchers for schools.');
    await specAndPlan(vouchers, 'invalid');
    await host.conn.request('admin.settings.set', { maxLiveAgents: 2 });
    // ---- Wishlist: everyone may take items; four items, two at work, one queued, one waiting; a question with votes
    const wish = await create('Wishlist', 'We want a wishlist for every reader.');
    await specAndPlan(wish, 4);
    await mei.conn.request('plan.suggest', { topicId: wish.topicId });
    await mei.conn.request('plan.mode.set', { topicId: wish.topicId, mode: 'everyone' });
    const { preflight } = await mei.conn.request('plan.preflight', { topicId: wish.topicId });
    await mei.conn.request('plan.start', { topicId: wish.topicId, planRevision: preflight.planRevision, specHash: preflight.specHash, planHash: preflight.planHash, agent: { permissionMode: 'ask-commands' } });
    const sessionsLedger = ledger['sessions'] as Record<string, string>;
    const wishPlan = await planIs(leo, wish.topicId, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'wish-list')?.sessionId !== undefined && itemOf(plan, 'wish-share')?.sessionId !== undefined, 'two wishlist items at work', 30_000);
    const wishList = itemOf(wishPlan, 'wish-list')?.sessionId as string;
    const wishShare = itemOf(wishPlan, 'wish-share')?.sessionId as string;
    sessionsLedger['wish-list'] = wishList;
    sessionsLedger['wish-share'] = wishShare;
    for (const id of [wishList, wishShare]) await host.watch(id);
    await permissionAt(host, (request) => request.sessionId === wishList && request.status === 'open', 'the command of the wish list');
    await waitUntil(() => host.events(wishShare).some((event) => event.kind === 'text' && event.text === 'Sharing is half done.'), 30_000, 'the share item at work');
    // Messages that wait for the share item's turn: a person's (with a mention), one from a selection, an accepted suggestion.
    await mei.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: wishShare, text: '@Kate and then add a share button.', mentions: ['dev:kate'] });
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: wishShare, text: 'In src/app.ts, line 1: export const title Rename it, please.', origin: 'selection' });
    const wishSuggestion = (await amy.conn.request('suggest.create', { sessionId: wishShare, text: 'keep the old link working', source: { file: { root: { kind: 'worktree', worktreeId: itemOf(wishPlan, 'wish-share')?.worktreeId as string }, path: 'src/wish/share/share.ts' }, startLine: 1, endLine: 1 } })).suggestion.id;
    await mei.conn.request('suggest.accept', { suggestionId: wishSuggestion });
    // The discussion asks; the plan and the spec are asked for while it waits (they wait for its turn).
    await mei.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: wish.discussionId, text: 'Tell us where the wishlist is kept.' });
    const where = await questionAt(leo, (question) => question.sessionId === wish.discussionId && question.status === 'open', 'the wishlist question');
    await host.conn.request('question.vote', { questionId: where.id, part: 0, options: [0] });
    await (people.kate as Member).conn.request('question.vote', { questionId: where.id, part: 0, options: [1] });
    await (people.kate as Member).conn.request('question.comment', { questionId: where.id, text: 'An account would follow people between devices.' });
    await host.conn.request('question.remind', { questionId: where.id });
    await mei.conn.request('plan.generate', { topicId: wish.topicId });
    await mei.conn.request('topic.spec.request', { topicId: wish.topicId });
    await mei.conn.request('topic.rule.add', { topicId: wish.topicId, tool: 'Bash', pattern: 'pnpm wish *' });
    // ---- A9: Mei's session that waits for a decision; A10: the host's session that failed
    const { session: a9 } = await mei.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Readme', firstMessage: 'Please tidy the readme.', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });
    sessionsLedger['A9-mei-agent-main-waiting-for-a-decision'] = a9.id;
    await host.watch(a9.id);
    const answer = async (what: string, decision: 'allow' | 'deny', by: Member): Promise<void> => {
      const request = await permissionAt(host, (candidate) => candidate.sessionId === a9.id && candidate.status === 'open', what);
      await by.conn.request('permission.decide', { requestId: request.id, decision });
      await waitUntil(() => host.permissions().find((candidate) => candidate.id === request.id)?.status !== 'open', 15_000, `${what} decided`);
    };
    // Every card of its first turn: the edit (Mei allows it), the read outside (the host refuses it), the tracker (allowed).
    for (let answered = 0; answered < 10 && host.events(a9.id).filter((event) => event.kind === 'turn.finished').length === 0; answered++) {
      const open = await permissionAt(host, (candidate) => candidate.sessionId === a9.id && candidate.status === 'open', 'a card of the readme session', 15_000).catch(() => null);
      if (open === null) break;
      if (open.tool === 'Edit') await answer('the edit of the readme', 'allow', mei);
      else if (open.what === 'outside' || open.tool === 'Read') await answer('the read outside', 'deny', host);
      else await answer(`the ${open.tool} of the readme session`, 'allow', host);
    }
    await turnsFinished(host, a9.id, 1, 30_000);
    await mei.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a9.id, text: 'Now change the readme.' });
    await permissionAt(host, (candidate) => candidate.sessionId === a9.id && candidate.status === 'open', 'the second edit of the readme');
    await mei.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: a9.id, text: 'And then tell bob.' });
    (ledger['suggestions'] as Record<string, string>)['s12-gina-pending-in-a-waiting-session'] = (await (people.gina as Member).conn.request('suggest.create', { sessionId: a9.id, text: 'Please also fix the typo in the title.' })).suggestion.id;
    const { session: a10 } = await host.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Crash', firstMessage: 'Please crash now.', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });
    sessionsLedger['A10-host-agent-failed'] = a10.id;
    await host.watch(a10.id);
    await statusIs(host, a10.id, 'failed', 30_000);
    // ---- Returns: a plan that does not parse, then the host ends its discussion (the topic has lost it)
    const returns = await create('Returns', 'People want returns within a month.');
    await specAndPlan(returns, 'invalid');
    await host.conn.request('admin.session.terminate', { sessionId: returns.discussionId });
    await topicIs(leo, returns.topicId, (topic) => topic.discussion === 'lost', 'the lost discussion');
    // ---- Refunds: the host answers the question in Mei's place; the discussion ends, starts again, the topic is renamed
    const refunds = await create('Refunds', 'We pay refunds in cash, or not?', 'refunds');
    const cash = await questionAt(leo, (question) => question.sessionId === refunds.discussionId && question.status === 'open', 'the refunds question');
    await host.conn.request('question.submit', { questionId: cash.id, answers: [{ options: [1] }] });
    await topicIs(leo, refunds.topicId, (topic) => topic.phase === 'spec', 'the refunds spec');
    await statusIs(leo, refunds.discussionId, 'idle', 30_000);
    await host.conn.request('admin.session.terminate', { sessionId: refunds.discussionId });
    await topicIs(leo, refunds.topicId, (topic) => topic.discussion === 'lost', 'the refunds discussion lost');
    const restarted = await mei.conn.request('topic.discussion.restart', { topicId: refunds.topicId });
    await leo.watch(restarted.session.id);
    await turnsFinished(leo, restarted.session.id, 1, 30_000);
    await mei.conn.request('topic.rename', { topicId: refunds.topicId, name: 'Refunds and credit' });
    // ---- Old idea: archived (an Editor's suggestion in it is closed); Short: archived and deleted by the host
    const old = await create('Old idea', 'This is an old idea.');
    await turnsFinished(leo, old.discussionId, 1, 30_000);
    (ledger['suggestions'] as Record<string, string>)['s13-amy-rejected-when-the-topic-was-archived'] = (await amy.conn.request('suggest.create', { sessionId: old.discussionId, text: 'Maybe later.' })).suggestion.id;
    await mei.conn.request('topic.archive', { topicId: old.topicId, archived: true });
    const short = await mei.conn.request('topic.create', { name: 'Short', firstMessage: 'A short topic.' });
    await leo.watch(short.session.id);
    await turnsFinished(leo, short.session.id, 1, 30_000);
    await mei.conn.request('topic.archive', { topicId: short.topic.id, archived: true });
    await host.conn.request('topic.delete', { topicId: short.topic.id });
    lastAsk = Date.now();
    // ---- Vouchers: its spec and its plan changed by another program (written straight into the folder)
    await writeFile(join(P.project, 'specs', 'vouchers', 'SPEC.md'), `${specText('Vouchers', 'Vouchers for schools.')}\nChanged by another program.\n`);
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1_500));
    await writeFile(join(P.project, 'specs', 'vouchers', 'PLAN.md'), `${await readFile(join(P.project, 'specs', 'vouchers', 'PLAN.md'), 'utf8')}\nChanged by another program.\n`);
  }, 900_000);

  step('run 5 (0.6.0): a teammate\'s session in auto mode, the workspace\'s default: commands that smurg\'s own gate asks the host about (a host-only file, outside the folder, a target it cannot read), three that auto mode\'s check refuses; a session whose model the agent cannot use', async () => {
    const kate = people.kate as Member;
    const sessionsLedger = ledger['sessions'] as Record<string, string>;
    const { session } = await kate.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Auto mode' });
    sessionsLedger['A12-kate-agent-in-auto-mode'] = session.id;
    await sessionReady(host, session.id);
    await host.watch(session.id);
    // Kate chooses auto mode for it herself (it follows the workspace, which is in auto mode: the choice is recorded).
    await kate.conn.request('session.mode.set', { sessionId: session.id, mode: 'auto' });
    let turns = 0;
    const ask = async (text: string, decision: 'allow' | 'deny' | null): Promise<void> => {
      await kate.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: session.id, text });
      if (decision !== null) {
        const request = await permissionAt(host, (candidate) => candidate.sessionId === session.id && candidate.status === 'open', text);
        note(`auto mode asks: ${JSON.stringify({ gate: request.gate, hostOnly: request.hostOnly, reason: request.reason })}`);
        await host.conn.request('permission.decide', { requestId: request.id, decision });
      }
      turns += 1;
      await turnsFinished(host, session.id, turns, 30_000);
    };
    await ask('Please write the host notes.', 'deny');
    await ask('Please write a note outside.', 'allow');
    // (In the main folder smurg's gate for the project's trusted scripts asks first about a target it cannot read.)
    await ask('Please write where the variable says.', 'deny');
    // In a worktree (whose project settings the host did not trust) the same command meets the row of auto mode.
    const { session: inWorktree } = await kate.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'worktree' }, title: 'Auto mode in a worktree' });
    sessionsLedger['A14-kate-agent-in-auto-mode-in-a-worktree'] = inWorktree.id;
    await sessionReady(host, inWorktree.id);
    await host.watch(inWorktree.id);
    await kate.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: inWorktree.id, text: 'Please write where the variable says.' });
    const unknown = await permissionAt(host, (candidate) => candidate.sessionId === inWorktree.id && candidate.status === 'open', 'the command whose target smurg cannot read');
    note(`auto mode asks in a worktree: ${JSON.stringify({ gate: unknown.gate, hostOnly: unknown.hostOnly })}`);
    await host.conn.request('permission.decide', { requestId: unknown.id, decision: 'deny' });
    await turnsFinished(host, inWorktree.id, 1, 30_000);
    await kate.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: session.id, text: 'Please try the installers.' });
    const third = await permissionAt(host, (candidate) => candidate.sessionId === session.id && candidate.status === 'open', 'the third command auto mode refused', 30_000).catch(() => null);
    if (third !== null) await host.conn.request('permission.decide', { requestId: third.id, decision: 'deny' });
    turns += 1;
    await turnsFinished(host, session.id, turns, 30_000);
    // A model the API refuses for this account: the session says so and offers to choose another one; Kate does.
    scenarioExtra = { refuseModels: ['fable'] };
    await setScenario();
    const { session: refused } = await kate.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'A model that is refused', firstMessage: 'Hello.', model: 'fable', permissionMode: 'ask-commands' });
    sessionsLedger['A13-kate-agent-model-refused'] = refused.id;
    await host.watch(refused.id);
    await waitUntil(() => host.events(refused.id).some((event) => event.kind === 'notice' && event.action === 'choose-model'), 30_000, 'the notice that the model is refused');
    await kate.conn.request('session.model.set', { sessionId: refused.id, model: 'sonnet' });
    scenarioExtra = {};
    await setScenario();
  });

  step('run 5: what the host and the people do with sessions: a rule of a session removed, a session\'s agent restarted, who is responsible, an entry of a conversation removed by the host, a topic\'s rule removed; an agent that dies while a question and a request wait (both withdrawn), tried again', async () => {
    const sessionsLedger = ledger['sessions'] as Record<string, string>;
    const a1 = sessionsLedger['A1-host-agent-main'] as string;
    const rule = (await host.conn.request('session.rules.get', { sessionId: a1 })).rules.find((one) => one.pattern === 'pnpm coverage *');
    if (rule !== undefined) await host.conn.request('session.rule.remove', { sessionId: a1, ruleId: rule.id });
    await host.conn.request('session.restart', { sessionId: a1 });
    await host.conn.request('session.responsible.set', { sessionId: a1, userId: mei.userId });
    const recite = host.events(a1).find((event) => event.kind === 'message' && event.text === 'Please recite slowly.');
    if (recite !== undefined) await host.conn.request('admin.transcript.redact', { sessionId: a1, seq: recite.seq });
    const wish = (ledger['topics'] as Record<string, { topicId: string }>)['wishlist'] as { topicId: string };
    const wishRule = (await host.conn.request('topic.list', {})).topics.find((topic) => topic.id === wish.topicId)?.rules.find((one) => one.pattern === 'pnpm wish *');
    if (wishRule !== undefined) await mei.conn.request('topic.rule.remove', { topicId: wish.topicId, ruleId: wishRule.id });
    // The host's session whose agent dies while its question waits, and again, after "Try again", while a command waits.
    const { session } = await host.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'agent', workspace: { mode: 'main' }, title: 'Broken while asking', permissionMode: 'ask-all' });
    sessionsLedger['A15-host-agent-dies-while-it-asks'] = session.id;
    await sessionReady(host, session.id);
    await host.watch(session.id);
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: session.id, text: 'Please ask and wait.' });
    await questionAt(host, (question) => question.sessionId === session.id && question.status === 'open', 'the question of the session that dies');
    expect(await killAgentOf(session.id)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await statusIs(host, session.id, 'failed', 30_000);
    await host.conn.request('session.retry', { sessionId: session.id });
    await host.conn.request('session.message.send', { sessionId: session.id, text: 'Please run something and wait.' });
    await permissionAt(host, (request) => request.sessionId === session.id && request.status === 'open', 'the command of the session that dies');
    expect(await killAgentOf(session.id)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    await statusIs(host, session.id, 'failed', 30_000);
  });

  step('run 5: an Editor writes 125 small files in a minute (120 in the audit log, the rest in its overflow file, a summary entry)', async () => {
    await amy.conn.request('file.create', { file: { root: MAIN_ROOT, path: 'bulk' }, kind: 'dir' });
    for (let round = 0; round < 5; round++) {
      await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 25 }, (_, index) => amy.conn.request('file.write', { file: { root: MAIN_ROOT, path: `bulk/counter-${index}.txt` }, content: bytes(`${round}\n`) })));
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    }
  });

  step('run 5: a member who uses the command: smurg login by device code with GitHub (the mock), smurg attach with the link whose web address is not the relay\'s; a second login at another name of the relay, logged out again', async () => {
    await mkdir(P.cliHome, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
    const env = hostEnv({ HOME: P.cliHome, SMURG_HOME: P.cliMember, SMURG_CACHE_DIR: join(P.cliHome, '.cache') });
    // ---- the login: the command prints a page and a code; the person logs in at the relay with GitHub and allows it
    const child = spawn(process.execPath, [CLI_MAIN, 'login', '--relay', relay.origin], { cwd: P.cliHome, env, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    if (child.pid !== undefined) registerTestProcess(child.pid, CLI_MAIN);
    let out = '';
    child.stdout.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => (out += chunk.toString('utf8')));
    child.stderr.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => (out += chunk.toString('utf8')));
    const exited = new Promise<number | null>((resolve) => child.once('exit', (code) => resolve(code)));
    await waitUntil(() => /Enter the code: [A-Z]{4}-[A-Z]{4}/.test(out), 30_000, 'the code of the device login');
    const code = /Enter the code: ([A-Z]{4}-[A-Z]{4})/.exec(out)?.[1] as string;
    const browser = new CookieBrowser();
    const startAt = new URL(relayHttpUrl(relay.origin, authLoginPath('github')));
    startAt.searchParams.set('return_to', RELAY_PATHS.device);
    await browser.get(startAt.href);
    const device = relayHttpUrl(relay.origin, RELAY_PATHS.device);
    await browser.submit(device, { code }, { origin: relay.origin });
    const allowed = await browser.submit(device, { code: normalizeDeviceUserCode(code) as string, account: 'github:12345', decision: 'allow' }, { origin: relay.origin });
    expect(allowed.body).toContain('data-state="allowed"');
    expect(await exited, out).toBe(0);
    // ---- smurg attach with the link of the last `smurg host` (agent access, the other web address): it lists the sessions
    const lastRun = ledger['lastRun'] as { teammatesLink: string };
    const attached = await smurg(['attach', '--relay', relay.origin, '--invite', '-'], { ...env, SMURG_INVITE: lastRun.teammatesLink }, `${lastRun.teammatesLink}\n`);
    note(`attach: ${attached.code} ${attached.out.split('\n').slice(0, 3).join(' / ')}`);
    expect(attached.code, attached.out).toBe(0);
    // ---- a second login at another name of the same relay, and out again
    const second = await smurg(['login', '--relay', webOrigin, '--dev-user', 'octo'], env);
    expect(second.code, second.out).toBe(0);
    const out2 = await smurg(['logout', '--relay', webOrigin], env);
    expect(out2.code, out2.out).toBe(0);
    ledger['cliMember'] = { attach: attached.out, login: 'github:12345 by device code (the mock GitHub of the relay tests)', secondLogin: `dev:octo at ${webOrigin}, logged out again` };
  });

  step('(b) the `stopped` picture of the 0.5.2 fixture, both its workspaces, made with the tree\'s own copy step and opened by this code (smurg host of each, smurg stop): the steps from 0.5.0 run, their kept copies stay', async () => {
    const copyRoot = join(ROOT, 'b052');
    const copied = copyPublishedFixture(join(TREE, 'packages', 'daemon', 'test', 'fixtures', 'published', '0.5.2'), 'stopped', copyRoot);
    const book = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(copied.hostHome, 'workspaces.json'), 'utf8')) as { shared: { folder: string; relay: string; workspaceId: string; createdAt: number }[] };
    const mine = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(P.host, 'workspaces.json'), 'utf8')) as { version: number; shared: unknown[]; joined: unknown[] };
    for (const entry of book.shared) {
      await rename(join(copied.hostHome, 'workspaces', entry.workspaceId), join(P.host, 'workspaces', entry.workspaceId));
      await rename(join(copied.hostHome, 'logs', `${entry.workspaceId}.log`), join(P.host, 'logs', `${entry.workspaceId}.log`));
      await mkdir(entry.folder, { recursive: true });
      // The one line of a stored file the driver writes: the folder's entry, with this relay.
      mine.shared.push({ folder: entry.folder, relay: relay.origin, workspaceId: entry.workspaceId, createdAt: entry.createdAt });
    }
    await writeFile(join(P.host, 'workspaces.json'), `${JSON.stringify(mine, null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
    const opened: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const entry of book.shared) {
      const run = await smurgHost(entry.folder, []);
      opened[entry.workspaceId] = { folder: entry.folder, hostLink: run.hostLink, teammatesLink: run.teammatesLink, printed: run.out().split('\n').filter((line) => /upgrade|earlier|kept|auto/i.test(line)) };
      await stopHost(run);
    }
    ledger['b052'] = opened;
  });

  step('(c) a shared folder without .git: smurg\'s own history (.smurg/git), a topic, a Start, a work item in its own checkout, a report, a review and a merge', async () => {

    await me.conn.request('plan.start', { topicId: created.topic.id, planRevision: preflight.planRevision, specHash: preflight.specHash, planHash: preflight.planHash });
    await planIs(me, created.topic.id, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'shelf-page')?.report?.state === 'to-review', 'the report of the notes item', 60_000);
    await me.conn.request('report.review', { topicId: created.topic.id, itemId: 'shelf-page', version: 1 });
    const draft = (await me.conn.request('report.get', { topicId: created.topic.id, itemId: 'shelf-page' })).report.changes?.requestId as string;
    expect((await me.conn.request('worktree.merge.approve', { requestId: draft })).request).toMatchObject({ status: 'merged' });
    // Kate joins this workspace too: in auto mode a command of her session whose target smurg cannot read asks the host

    await me.watch(auto.id);
