    const unknown = await permissionAt(me, (candidate) => candidate.sessionId === auto.id && candidate.status === 'open', 'the command whose target smurg cannot read');
    note(`auto mode asks without git: ${JSON.stringify({ gate: unknown.gate, hostOnly: unknown.hostOnly })}`);
    await me.conn.request('permission.decide', { requestId: unknown.id, decision: 'deny' });
    await turnsFinished(me, auto.id, 1, 30_000);
    const { session: kept } = await kateHere.conn.request('session.create', { kind: 'terminal', workspace: { mode: 'worktree' }, cols: 80, rows: 24, title: 'Kate in a checkout of smurg\'s history' });
    await kateHere.conn.request('session.end', { sessionId: kept.id, keepWorktree: true });
    kateHere.client.close();
    ledger['nogit'] = { workspaceId: run.workspaceId, folder, topicId: created.topic.id, kateLink };
    me.client.close();
    await stopHost(run);
  });

  step('(d) smurg host with no git program on PATH: a Start that the host confirms, whose work item runs directly in the shared folder and is reported without a diff', async () => {
    const folder = join(ROOT, 'direct');
    await mkdir(join(folder, 'src'), { recursive: true });
    await writeFile(join(folder, 'README.md'), '# Without git at all\n');
    extraTurns = [...DIRECT_TURNS(), ...extraTurns];
    await setScenario();
    const run = await smurgHost(folder, ['--name', 'Direct'], hostEnv({}, `${P.claudeDir}:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin`));
    const me = member(await connect(await deviceOf('host'), run.workspaceId, run.hostLink), 'Host', 'host');
    await me.sync();
    const created = await me.conn.request('topic.create', { name: 'Price tags', firstMessage: 'Price tags printed straight from the folder.' });
    await me.watch(created.session.id);
    await topicIs(me, created.topic.id, (topic) => topic.phase === 'spec', 'the spec of the price tags', 30_000);
    await statusIs(me, created.session.id, 'idle', 30_000);
    await me.conn.request('plan.generate', { topicId: created.topic.id });
    await planIs(me, created.topic.id, (plan) => plan.items.length === 1, 'the plan of the price tags', 30_000);
    await statusIs(me, created.session.id, 'idle', 30_000);
    const { preflight } = await me.conn.request('plan.preflight', { topicId: created.topic.id });
    note(`the preflight with no git program: ${JSON.stringify(preflight).slice(0, 300)}`);
    await me.conn.request('plan.start', { topicId: created.topic.id, planRevision: preflight.planRevision, specHash: preflight.specHash, planHash: preflight.planHash, direct: true });
    await planIs(me, created.topic.id, (plan) => itemOf(plan, 'tag-print')?.report !== undefined, 'the report of the direct item', 60_000);
    ledger['direct'] = { workspaceId: run.workspaceId, folder, topicId: created.topic.id };
    me.client.close();
    await stopHost(run);
  });

  step('run 5: the Bookshop waits six and a half minutes (a report is escalated after six times the host\'s minute, questions and requests after one), then the host reviews a report in the place of the member responsible for it', async () => {
    // (SMURG_FX_WAIT_MS: a shorter wait while the driver is being made; the fixture is made with the whole one.)
    const wait = Number.parseInt(process.env['SMURG_FX_WAIT_MS'] ?? String(6.5 * 60_000), 10);
    const waitUntilAt = Math.max(waitFrom + wait, lastAsk + Math.min(wait, 90_000));
    while (Date.now() < waitUntilAt) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 15_000));
      note(`waiting: ${Math.round((waitUntilAt - Date.now()) / 1000)} s left`);
    }
    const gift = (ledger['topics'] as Record<string, { topicId: string }>)['gift-cards'] as { topicId: string };
    const model = (await host.conn.request('report.get', { topicId: gift.topicId, itemId: 'card-model' })).report;
    note(`the card model before the host's review: ${JSON.stringify({ version: model.version, state: model.state, escalatedAt: (model as { escalatedAt?: number }).escalatedAt })}`);
    await host.conn.request('report.review', { topicId: gift.topicId, itemId: 'card-model', version: model.version }).catch((err: unknown) => note(`the host's review of the card model: ${String(err)}`));
  }, 900_000);

  // ==== THE END: the pictures and the fixture =========================================================================
  step('the picture `running` (smurg host of the Bookshop running), smurg stop, the picture `stopped`', async () => {
    await picture('running');
    if (runs.includes(A)) await stopHost(A);
    await picture('stopped');
  }, 600_000, true);

  step('the fixture: files.json with the stored files, coverage.json, ledger.json', async () => {
    await writeFixture();
  }, 600_000, true);
});
